# Director of Data Engineering

Dublin, Ireland

**Who We Are**

At 2K, we create some of the most iconic and culture-shaping video games in entertainment, including NBA® 2K, one of the top-selling franchises in the world, and legendary titles like BioShock®, Borderlands®, Mafia, Sid Meier’s Civilization®, and XCOM®, as well as fan favorites WWE® 2K, TopSpin®, and PGA TOUR® 2K. We build unforgettable experiences by pushing the boundaries of creativity, authenticity and innovation across every genre.

Our portfolio is brought to life by some of the most influential game development studios in the world. Visual Concepts, Firaxis Games, Hangar 13, Cat Daddy Games, 31st Union, Cloud Chamber, Gearbox, HB Studios, and 2K SportsLab create world-class experiences across platforms.

But what truly powers 2K is our people.

We believe the best ideas come from teams that feel empowered, supported, and inspired. As an equal opportunity employer, we are committed to fostering a diverse, inclusive workplace where people are encouraged to come as they are and do their best work.

**What We Need**

The **Director of Data Engineering** is a technical and strategic powerhouse responsible for architecting the data foundations that power 2K’s global ecosystem. This role oversees the engineering strategy, telemetry standards, and infrastructure framework that transforms raw player interactions into high-fidelity, actionable intelligence.

You will lead the evolution of our data platform, moving beyond traditional ETL toward a proactive, AI-integrated environment. As a natural "bridge builder," you will partner deeply with Studio leads and cross-functional executives to expand the remit of data engineering. Crucially, you will act as a steward of our resources, applying **FinOps principles** to ensure our infrastructure is high-performing, cost-efficient, and that every technical investment delivers clear business value—ensuring the "juice is always worth the squeeze."

**What You’ll Do**

**Architect 2K’s Next-Gen Data Strategy**

* Lead a forward-looking data engineering vision that scales across Sports, Core, and R&D, prioritizing high-scale telemetry and proactive data modeling.
* Transition 2K’s infrastructure toward AI-augmented data processing, leveraging tools like Snowflake Cortex or Databricks Genie to automate and optimize the data lifecycle.

**Drive FinOps & Infrastructure Efficiency**

* Own the cloud infrastructure budget, implementing rigorous FinOps practices to monitor, manage, and optimize data processing costs.
* Evaluate technical debt versus innovation, ensuring all platform scaling is economically sustainable and tied to measurable ROI.

**Own the End-to-End Telemetry Lifecycle**

* Drive the strategy for telemetry design and implementation, ensuring an intimate connection between game-client events and downstream analytical value.
* Establish rigorous telemetry standards that ensure high-signal, low-latency data capture across all titles and platforms.

**Build the Platform for ML Ops & Proactive Modeling**

* Design and scale a dedicated ML Ops framework that allows Data Scientists to deploy, monitor, and iterate on AI models with industry-leading efficiency.
* Champion the use of proactive modeling to predict player needs and business trends before they occur.

**Expand Impact Through Strategic Partnerships**

* Act as a key relationship builder, creating strong alliances with Studio Engineering, DevOps, and Commercial leadership to align data roadmaps with product goals.
* Navigate complex partner dynamics with diplomacy, building trust and expanding the Data Engineering team's influence across the broader organization.
* Partner tightly with the Director of Product of 2K Data to define and deliver upon a modern and comprehensive data strategy.

**Build, Lead & Develop a High-Performing Engineering Team**

* Hire, mentor, and grow a world-class team of data engineers, telemetry specialists, and ML platform engineers.
* Foster a culture of technical rigor, financial accountability, and "bridge-building" collaboration.
* Foster an internal culture of innovation and fearless technical thought leadership throughout the data teams

**What Will Make You A Great Fit**

* Extensive experience in Data Engineering or Software Engineering, with a heavy emphasis on high-scale distributed systems and telemetry.
* Proven Success leading or managing engineering teams in complex, multi-title environments with proven track record of promoting engineers in both title and breadth of technical expertise
* **Intimate knowledge of Telemetry:** You understand the nuances of event-driven architecture and how to design schemas that capture the "heartbeat" of a product.
* **Experience in Streaming Telemetry and Feature Pipelines**: Solid understanding and experience in delivering large-scale, global data streaming services with scalable and sustainable architecture to support real-time machine learning operations and features
* **FinOps Mentality:** Proven ability to manage large-scale cloud budgets, optimizing for both performance and cost-efficiency.
* **Master Relationship Builder:** You have a track record of turning "difficult" technical partners into advocates and successfully expanding your team's strategic remit.
* **Growth Mindset:** Indexes toward learning through challenges and didactic learning patterns to bring about change at the individual and organizational levels.
* **Experience in Matrix-driven and Product-led Environments:** Able to successfully operate and thrive in matrixed environments led by product strategies and roadmaps.
* **A Track Record of Operational Excellence:** You have demonstrated experience upleveling global data operations and a deep understanding of SRE or DevOps principles. You don't just maintain systems; you build the guardrails, automation, and infrastructure needed to scale them reliably.

**Bonus Points**

* **Full-Lifecycle Data Science & ML Enablement:** Comprehensive experience across the data science lifecycle, from exploratory data analysis and feature engineering to model deployment and monitoring.
* **Software Engineering Background:** Strong experience in full-stack development or systems architecture.
* **Game Engine Expertise:** Hands-on experience with **Unreal Engine, Unity,** or proprietary game engines, specifically regarding how they emit data.
* **AI Fluency:** Experience with Snowflake Cortex, Databricks Genie, Langchain, Rust or similar AI-integrated data platforms.
* **Passion for games** and a player-focused mindset.

As an equal opportunity employer, we are committed to ensuring that qualified individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform their essential job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment. Please contact us if you need reasonable accommodation.

# Senior Analyst WWE and PGA

Dublin, Ireland

**Who We Are**

2K is headquartered in Novato, California and is a wholly owned label of Take-Two Interactive Software, Inc. (NASDAQ: TTWO). Founded in 2005, 2K Games is a global video game company, publishing titles developed by some of the most influential game development studios in the world. Our studios responsible for developing 2K’s portfolio of world-class games across multiple platforms, include Visual Concepts, Firaxis, Hangar 13, CatDaddy, Cloud Chamber, 31st Union, HB Studios, and 2K SportsLab. Our portfolio of titles is expanding due to our global strategic plan, building and acquiring exciting studios whose content continues to inspire all of us! 2K publishes titles in today’s most popular gaming genres, including sports, shooters, action, role-playing, strategy, casual, and family entertainment.

Our team of engineers, marketers, artists, writers, data scientists, producers, thinkers and doers, are the professional publishing stewards of 2K’s portfolio currently includes several AAA, sports and entertainment brands, including global powerhouse NBA®️ 2K,  renowned BioShock®️, Borderlands®️, Mafia, Sid Meier’s Civilization®️ and XCOM®️ brands; popular WWE®️ 2K and WWE®️ SuperCard franchises, TopSpin 2K25, as well as the critically and commercially acclaimed PGA TOUR®️ 2K

At 2K, we pride ourselves on creating an inclusive work environment, which means encouraging our teams to Come as You Are and do your best work! We encourage ALL applicants to explore our global positions, even if they don’t meet every requirement for the role.  If you're interested in the job and think you have what it takes to work at 2K, we encourage you to apply!

**What We Need**

We’re looking for a passionate Senior Data Analyst to support the WWE & PGAT Game Science & Insights team, to explore, analyze, report, and action on data from our portfolio of titles (WWE 2K, PGA TOUR 2K). We’re looking for someone who can translate product & business knowledge into deep analysis and, in turn, translate to actionable insights for cross functional business stakeholders. As you deliver valuable insights to stakeholders, you will aim to build strong relationships, become a trusted partner among business functions, and scale out team efforts from one team to the next. Our mission is to enable our partners to be more proactive, productive & successful by providing best in class, end-to-end and scalable data solutions.

**What You Will Do**

* Leverage a deep understanding of how our titles’ game features & mechanics work and our business priorities to deliver actionable, business-impacting insights
* Support business narratives and develop business cases with effective data storytelling. Focus on using data and hypothesis-driven decision-making to drive future growth and customer lifetime value
* Learn different business teams’ and stakeholders’ ways of working and preferences for understanding data, and be a bridge between the data team and business teams (Product, Marketing, Commercial) to translate complex business needs into data-related projects
* Tailor the output to match stakeholder needs, including reports, visualizations, charts, and tables
* Gain an understanding of internal titles outside of our portfolio (NBA 2K, Borderlands, other 2K titles) to provide strong benchmarking and comparison points for business performance
* Drive the exploration of creative new ways of measurement to identify patterns and causal relationships
* Empower teams to track and analyze activity/productivity and support their research projects, leading the efforts towards building scalable self-service tools
* Support analysts and other data-users to improve their capabilities, and contribute to both the team and wider business understanding of our players
* Data doesn't just appear overnight, we work with our stakeholders to understand what data matters most to their business and strategy. In addition to delivering insights on what is available to us, this role will be responsible for liaising with stakeholders to proactively identify what data we need to begin to record for future initiatives that drive value

**Who We Think Will Be a Great Fit**

The ideal candidate for this role has the ability to see the underlying story in the data, know how to ask the right questions and relate output back to measurable player or business outcomes. A solution-oriented and creative problem solver. A self-starter with the passion and enthusiasm to join a growing insights team to get results for meaningful change.

**Qualifications:**

* Track record of successfully leading the delivery of insights and analysis across business functions (Product, Commercial, Marketing)
* Proven ability to produce impactful insights that resulted in tangible enhancements to product or business outcomes
* Profound knowledge in SQL
* Great communication skills and a clear understanding of how to make insights understandable and actionable for the business
* High degree of proactivity and curiosity to understand, measure, and improve our understanding of our players and their behaviour
* Ability to lead the delivery of complex projects and manage changing priorities
* Understanding internal customer satisfaction as one of your key success factors
* Profound experience in data modeling (strong nice to have: data science language, such as Python or R)
* Experience in data visualization tools, such as Tableau
* Video games experience & passion - particularly in sports titles

# AV Support Technician

We are seeking a customer-focused and proactive On-Site AV Support Technician to oversee, maintain, and troubleshoot our corporate office audio-visual systems. In this role, you will serve as the primary technical contact for hybrid meeting rooms, corporate events, and day-to-day collaboration technology across the office.

You will ensure seamless audio, video, and presentation experiences for all employees, provide real-time support during critical meetings, and keep our AV infrastructure running smoothly.

Key Responsibilities

* Meeting & Event Support: Provide hands-on, pre-meeting checks and live technical support for town halls, executive meetings, and team video conferences.
* Troubleshooting & Maintenance: Diagnose and resolve hardware, software, connectivity, and room control issues quickly to minimize downtime.
* Daily Room Readiness: Perform routine sweeps across all meeting rooms, huddle spaces, and boardrooms to verify equipment performance, cable hygiene, and system functionality.
* System Operations: Configure and manage unified communication systems, display feeds, wireless screen-sharing solutions, and central control interfaces.
* Inventory & Vendor Coordination: Track AV equipment assets, log service requests, and liaise with external vendors and IT teams for maintenance and hardware replacements.
* User Support & Training: Help employees get comfortable using meeting room technology and maintain simple operational guides for self-service spaces.

Required Qualifications & Technical Skills

1. Video Conferencing & Collaboration Systems

* Solid experience operating major enterprise video conferencing platforms and soft-codec room systems.
* Familiarity with hybrid meeting room workflows and unified communications setup.

2. AV Control & Signal Distribution

* Hands-on experience operating room control systems, touch panels, and digital signal routing hardware.
* Practical understanding of audio-visual switchers, signal extenders, and wireless presentation equipment.

3. Audio Systems & Sound Processing

* Working knowledge of audio digital signal processors (DSPs) and sound reinforcement setups.
* Experience setting up and troubleshooting installed ceiling arrays, boundary microphones, and wireless microphone systems.
* Understanding of core audio principles, including gain staging, echo cancellation, and room acoustics.

4. Displays & Presentation Hardware

* Familiarity with commercial displays, interactive whiteboards, LED walls, and projection systems.
* Basic understanding of digital signage systems and content distribution across office spaces.

5. Cabling & Network Fundamentals

* Basic understanding of AV-over-IP standards and networked audio protocols.
* Knowledge of standard networking concepts (IP addressing, VLAN basics, PoE) as applied to AV hardware.
* Experience with standard video and audio cabling standards (HDMI, USB-C, DisplayPort, and network patch cables).

Preferred Certifications & Experience

* Industry-standard AV or IT certifications (e.g., general AV technology fundamentals, control system certifications, or networking fundamentals).
* 2+ years of hands-on experience providing technical AV or desktop support within a professional corporate or enterprise environment.

Key Soft Skills

* Professional Presence: Calm under pressure and comfortable assisting executives, external clients, and large audiences.
* Strong Communication: Clear, user-friendly communication style with the ability to explain technical steps to non-technical users.
* Problem-Solving: Adaptable problem-solver capable of applying quick, effective workarounds during live events.

AALTO, a global leader in Stratospace. Based in Farnborough, AALTO is an Airbus subsidiary that manufactures, operates, and delivers services with its solar-powered, stratospheric platform: Zephyr.

Join us as we create a new domain of aerospace: Stratospace. You'll be part of a highly-skilled, innovative and passionate group of people - Team AALTO. Together, we can Unlock Stratospace.

**About The Role**

Join AALTO as **Director, Flight Test Engineering** and take ownership of all phases of development testing for one of the world's most innovative aerospace programmes.

This senior leadership role is responsible for managing and mentoring the Flight Test Engineering team while overseeing the planning, execution, and reporting of ground and flight test activities. Working closely with stakeholders across engineering, certification, and operations, you will ensure testing activities support development objectives, certification requirements, and safe aircraft operation.

You will play a critical role in domestic and international flight test campaigns, customer demonstrations, and operational evaluations while serving as the Flight Test Post Holder within a Part 21J Design Organisation.

**Responsibilities to include:**

· Provide inspirational leadership and technical direction to the Flight Test Engineering team.

· Manage the technical scope, priorities, and day-to-day activities of flight test engineers.

· Lead the planning and delivery of ground and flight test programmes to support certification and development objectives.

· Support domestic and international flight test campaigns, including deployment to operational locations as required.

· Act as the Flight Test Post Holder within a Part 21J Design Organisation.

· Champion a culture of safety, professionalism, compliance, and continuous improvement.

· Work with stakeholders to gather, analyse, and derive test requirements.

· Oversee the management and delivery of individual test programmes and activities.

· Ensure robust impact assessments are completed when changes are introduced.

· Verify that aircraft systems and subsystems meet defined requirements and performance expectations.

· Evaluate new functionality, system modifications, and product enhancements through structured testing activities.

· Ensure testing is conducted in accordance with AALTO development standards and processes.

· Oversee the configuration, maintenance, and utilisation of test equipment and testing tools.

· Provide clear reporting and recommendations to support programme and business decision-making.

**Skills and Knowledge Required**

* Proven leadership experience with the ability to inspire, develop, and motivate high-performing technical teams.
* Extensive experience within aerospace flight test, flight sciences, certification, or developmental testing environments.
* Experience working with Aviation Regulators and/or Part 21 organisations.
* Strong technical and operational judgement with the ability to make decisions in high-pressure environments.
* Willingness and ability to travel internationally in support of flight test activities.
* Experience evaluating aerospace software and hardware systems.
* Strong understanding of flight sciences principles and aircraft performance.
* Experience testing safety-critical systems, ideally within the aerospace sector.

* Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.
* Strong planning, risk management, and programme coordination capabilities.
* Approximately 10 years' experience within the aviation or aerospace industry.
* Experience working with uncrewed air systems (UAS).
* Experience supporting flight test programmes for aircraft under development.

# Senior Product Manager, Technical (m/f/d)

Dublin, Dublin, Ireland

**About the Company**

**Affinidi**is a technology company dedicated to changing data ownership for good. We empower businesses and individuals with control and ownership of their data, with a comprehensive approach to managing their holistic identity – accounting for all aspects of their digital footprint while ensuring privacy and security.

Affinidi’s technology enables users to benefit from decentralised digital identity solutions. We believe that everyone has the right to own and control their data, and we are committed to creating a trusted digital credentials ecosystem that empowers businesses and individuals to securely exchange data and services across borders and industries.

---

We’re looking for a Senior Product Manager (Technical) who wants to help define how trust is built into the next generation of AI systems. At Affinidi, we’re building the Trust Fabric product suite to give AI agents verifiable identity, policy guardrails, and real-time observability, so organisations can move from promising proofs of concept to secure, governed production deployments with confidence. 

This is a role for builders. You’ll work side by side with engineering to turn ambitious ideas into real, high-impact products, fast, iteratively, and with strong product judgment. You’ll take on complex, ambiguous challenges that don’t come with a playbook, bring structure to what matters, and help the team move with clarity, speed, and conviction. You’ll also collaborate with deeply engaged teams and senior leaders in an environment that expects high standards, values ownership, and gives you the chance to shape meaningful products from the ground up. 

If you like combining technical depth, product thinking, and execution, you’ll fit right in. 

**What you’ll be doing** 

* ***Shape and deliver solutions**:*** Partner closely with engineers to define and refine solutions early, helping move ideas from concept to production in practical, incremental steps while staying close enough to implementation to understand trade-offs and guide decisions.
* ***Drive focused, outcome-oriented delivery:***Balance user needs, market context, and execution speed while focusing on getting working solutions into users’ hands for validation, then iterate based on feedback and measurable outcomes.
* ***Work through ambiguity******:*** Take ownership of areas where requirements are not fully defined, structure problems into clear, actionable paths forward, and maintain momentum even as direction continues to evolve.
* ***Own product direction:***Contribute to product strategy and roadmap definition, align short-term priorities with longer-term platform thinking, and make thoughtful trade-offs that support both delivery and scalability.
* ***Collaborate across stakeholders**:*** Work across engineering, design, and go-to-market teams, engage effectively with senior and executive stakeholders, and bring alignment and clarity in environments with diverse perspectives.
* ***Be developer-obsessed******:*** Understand developer workflows and key pain points, and help improve integration, usability, and the overall product experience.

 **What we’re looking for** 

* ***Core experience**:*** You bring 5+ years of experience in Technical Product Management, a strong technical background that lets you engage deeply with engineering topics, hands-on experience working with APIs, systems, and integrations, and a proven track record of delivering products in close collaboration with engineering teams.
* ***Technical depth**:*** You are comfortable understanding how systems are designed and operate in practice, able to engage in technical discussions, challenge assumptions, and evaluate trade-offs, and willing to go into detail when needed by reviewing flows, investigating issues, or clarifying implementation approaches.
* ***Mindset*****:** You take ownership from problem to outcome, are comfortable working with ambiguity and evolving priorities, combine structured thinking with a bias toward action, and can move between big-picture strategy and practical execution.
* ***Collaboration & communication*****:** You communicate effectively across technical and non-technical audiences, are comfortable working with experienced, highly engaged stakeholders, and know how to build alignment and drive decisions forward.
* ***Nice to have*****:** It’s a plus if you have had exposure to identity, distributed systems, or similar domains, and experience in fast-paced, product-led environments.

**What you’ll get** 

* A team that values ownership, quality, and speed
* Close collaboration between product and engineering
* Hybrid working model in Berlin + flexible hours
* Unlimited vacation
* Competitive compensation
* A strong environment to learn, build, and have impact

* Drive static timing analysis (STA), timing closure, clock-domain crossing (CDC) correctness, and constraint quality
* Debug designs through simulation, SignalTap / on-chip debug, and lab bring-up as required
* Contribute to design examples, simulation models, and technical documentation for internal and customer use

* Work effectively within engineering infrastructure including Perforce, GitHub, Jenkins, and TeamCity
* Support continuous integration, regression flows, and release quality for IP and reference designs
* Collaborate with software, systems, and applications engineers on HW/SW co-design and platform integration, including robotics software stacks where applicable (e.g. ROS2)
* Support platform bring-up, validation, and resolution of customer or internal technical issues

* Hands-on experience with RTL verification and simulation (e.g. ModelSim/Questa, VCS, or equivalent)
* Proven ability to close timing and optimize resource utilization on real FPGA designs
* Working knowledge of Quartus Prime and Platform Designer (or equivalent FPGA toolchain and system integration flows)

* Strong analytical, debug, and problem-solving skills, with clear written and verbal communication

* Deep understanding of FPGA architecture, pipelining, CDC, constraints, and STA best practices

* Prior exposure to robotics systems and robotics software stacks (e.g. ROS / ROS2) is a strong plus, enabling closer alignment of FPGA IP capabilities with end-application requirements

Únete a **Amaris Consulting** y participa en proyectos tecnológicos de alto impacto dentro de un entorno internacional, multidisciplinar e innovador. Formarás parte de un equipo que trabaja en el desarrollo de soluciones avanzadas en **fotónica integrada**, desde el diseño del circuito fotónico hasta su fabricación, caracterización y validación.

🎯 Tu misión e impacto

Como **Ingeniero/a de Fotónica Integrada / Silicon Photonics**, desempeñarás un papel clave en el **diseño y desarrollo de circuitos fotónicos integrados (PIC)**, participando en las diferentes etapas del ciclo de desarrollo del dispositivo: desde el diseño y layout hasta el tape-out, la fabricación y la caracterización de los chips.

Trabajarás en colaboración con equipos multidisciplinares de **electrónica, óptica, RF, packaging y test**, contribuyendo al desarrollo de soluciones fotónicas para aplicaciones avanzadas en ámbitos como las telecomunicaciones, comunicaciones ópticas, espacio y sensórica.

✅ Lo que buscamos

* Grado o Máster en **Ingeniería de Telecomunicaciones, Electrónica, Física, Fotónica, Óptica** o una disciplina similar.
* Se valorará formación específica en **fotónica integrada / Silicon Photonics**.
* Experiencia en **diseño y desarrollo de circuitos o chips fotónicos integrados (PIC)**.
* Experiencia en al menos **1–2 proyectos de fabricación mediante una foundry fotónica**.
* Conocimiento del flujo completo de desarrollo de un chip fotónico: **diseño → layout → tape-out → fabricación → caracterización y test**.
* Experiencia trabajando con **PDKs (Process Design Kits)** de una foundry fotónica.
* Conocimiento de componentes fotónicos integrados, como:
* Waveguides.
* Couplers / splitters.
* Grating couplers.
* Moduladores.
* Fotodetectores.
* Ring resonators.
* MZI (Mach-Zehnder Interferometers).
* Multiplexores y demultiplexores.
* Experiencia con herramientas de **diseño y simulación fotónica**.
* Se valorará experiencia con herramientas como **Lumerical, Synopsys, Ansys, KLayout, Nazca, IPKISS** u otras equivalentes.
* Conocimientos de **layout y diseño para fabricación**.
* Experiencia trabajando con una o varias **foundries de fotónica integrada**.
* Experiencia en la preparación de **tape-outs** y conocimiento de las restricciones de fabricación asociadas a los PDKs.
* Se valorará experiencia en la **caracterización y validación de chips fotónicos fabricados**.
* Se valorará experiencia con tecnologías **Silicon Photonics (SiPh)**.
* Se valorará también experiencia con plataformas **SiN, InP, GaAs** u otras tecnologías fotónicas.
* Se valorará experiencia en aplicaciones de **espacio, comunicaciones ópticas, sensores o telecomunicaciones**.
* Capacidad para trabajar en **proyectos multidisciplinares** junto a equipos de electrónica, óptica, RF, packaging y test.
* **Inglés técnico** suficiente para trabajar con documentación científica, proveedores y foundries.
* Capacidad para trabajar de forma integral, desde el **diseño hasta la fabricación y validación** del dispositivo.
* Capacidad de trabajo autónomo y colaborativo, con orientación a la resolución de problemas y al desarrollo de soluciones técnicas.

* Trabajar con **PDKs de foundries fotónicas**, aplicando sus reglas y restricciones de diseño.
* Desarrollar y revisar **layouts** preparados para fabricación.
* Participar en la preparación y revisión de **tape-outs**.
* Colaborar con foundries durante las diferentes fases del proceso de fabricación.
* Participar en la **caracterización, test y validación** de los chips fabricados.
* Analizar resultados experimentales y contribuir a la optimización de los diseños.
* Trabajar conjuntamente con equipos de **electrónica, óptica, RF, packaging y test** para garantizar la correcta integración del dispositivo.
* Participar en decisiones técnicas y aportar soluciones innovadoras a los retos de diseño y fabricación.

At Ascom, we're a global healthcare technology company with more than 160 years of innovation. Our solutions support healthcare professionals around the world by improving communication, coordination, and clinical workflows across healthcare environments.

To support our global HR organisation, we are looking for an experienced **HR Systems Expert** to join our Global HR team.

This is an exciting opportunity for someone who enjoys combining HR knowledge with systems expertise, process improvement, and stakeholder collaboration. You will play an important role in ensuring our HR systems run effectively, support our people processes, and deliver reliable data and insights to the business.

Working closely with HR colleagues, IT teams, external vendors, and key stakeholders, you will help maintain, improve, and optimise our HR technology landscape while supporting global HR projects and initiatives.

**About the Role**

As our HR Systems Expert, you will be responsible for the day-to-day management and continuous improvement of our HR systems. You will act as a key point of contact for system users, support process optimisation, coordinate enhancements, and help ensure data quality, compliance, and operational excellence across our HR technology environment.

Success in this role requires a structured and proactive approach, strong stakeholder management skills, and the ability to coordinate multiple initiatives and priorities across a global organisation.

**Your Key Responsibilities**

* Manage and support global and local HR systems, including HRIS, talent management, and payroll platforms.
* Coordinate system enhancements, upgrades, testing, and continuous improvement activities.
* Ensure the accuracy, integrity, security, and compliance of HR data across all systems.
* Create and maintain reports, dashboards, and analytics to support HR and business decision-making.
* Provide user support, guidance, and training, translating system capabilities into practical solutions.
* Coordinate with external vendors and monitor service delivery against agreed service levels.
* Identify opportunities to improve processes, increase efficiency, and enhance the user experience.
* Support global HR projects through effective planning, coordination, communication, and stakeholder management.

We're looking for a collaborative and detail-oriented professional with strong organisational skills and a passion for improving HR processes and systems.

* A Bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Information Technology, Business Administration, or a related field.
* 3-5+ years of experience working with HR systems and HR technology solutions.
* Experience supporting HRIS implementations, upgrades, or enhancement projects.
* Strong analytical skills and experience with reporting and dashboard tools.
* Sound understanding of HR processes and operational practices.
* Excellent communication, coordination, and stakeholder management skills.
* Strong organisational and project coordination capabilities, with the ability to manage multiple priorities.
* A proactive and solution-focused mindset with attention to detail.
* Experience working in an international environment and collaborating across countries and functions.

**Why Join Ascom?**

At Ascom, you'll have the opportunity to:

* Work with colleagues across a global organisation.
* Contribute to the continuous improvement of HR systems and processes.
* Participate in international HR projects and initiatives.
* Develop your expertise in HR technology and data management.
* Work in a collaborative environment that values innovation, ownership, and continuous improvement.

**Make an Impact**

If you're passionate about HR systems, process optimisation, and delivering excellent support to users and stakeholders, we'd love to hear from you.

Join Ascom and help us create efficient, reliable, and user-friendly HR systems that support our people and our business.

We're looking for a Senior Software Engineer to join our FinOps team in London. ASOS runs a large Azure estate behind a platform used by millions of customers, and every architectural decision made across our engineering teams has a cost attached to it.

FinOps exists to make that cost visible, attributable and actionable, helping engineering teams understand what their services cost and make better technical decisions.

* Full-time

## Company Description

We’re ASOS, the online retailer for fashion lovers all around the world.

We exist to give our customers the confidence to be whoever they want to be, and that goes for our people too. At ASOS, you’re free to be your true self without judgement, and channel your creativity into a platform used by millions.

But how are we showing up? We’re proud members of Inclusive Companies, are Disability Confident Committed and have signed the Business in the Community Race at Work Charter and we placed 8th in the Inclusive Top 50 Companies Employer list.

Everyone needs some help showing up as their best self. Let our Talent team know if you need any adjustments throughout the process in whatever way works best for you.

## Job Description

**About The Role**

ASOS is looking for a Brand Planning Manager to join the Brand & Planning Marketing team. This is a planning role responsible for leading, translating brand and business strategy into one integrated, prioritised and executable global brand plan.

The role sits at the handover point between strategy and execution. It will connect Brand Strategy, Brand Marketing, Brand Heat, Product, Commercial, Performance Marketing, Creative, channel teams, agencies and local markets, turning strategic direction into clear annual and seasonal plans, market-ready calendars, channel roles, investment principles and measurable outcomes.

Working closely with the Global Brand & Planning Marketing Lead, the Brand Planning Manager will own the day-to-day planning rhythm across the year, lead market engagement and the communications model, and create the clarity, governance and decision points needed to move plans forward. The role will not own campaign creative briefing. Its focus is ensuring that strategy is translated into an aligned plan which enables teams to brief, develop and execute effectively.

This role will combine integrated planning leadership, market partnership, cross-functional influence and operational ownership, while providing senior direction and quality assurance across the team’s reporting and effectiveness work so that insight consistently feeds forward into future plans.

**Why This Role Matters**

The Brand & Planning Marketing team is building a more connected operating system across planning, execution and effectiveness. The Brand Planning Manager will help create the capacity and senior ownership needed for the Global Brand & Planning Marketing Lead to focus primarily on strategic planning, while ensuring reporting remains well governed, decision-oriented and connected to the plan.

The role will act as a planning control tower for Brand Marketing: creating one view of the global and local calendar, clarifying ownership and dependencies, bringing market “Fit to Win” needs into planning, and ensuring agreed plans move confidently from strategic direction into channel and market execution.

What You Will Be Responsible For

1. Integrated Annual & Seasonal Brand Planning

* Maintain the integrated full-year brand plan and four seasonal plans, connecting brand priorities, product and commercial inputs, customer and cultural moments, campaign types, channel roles, markets and investment.
* Translate strategy into clear planning parameters, priorities, phasing, sequencing, success measures and decision points that enable execution teams to develop channel and campaign responses.
* Lead the day-to-day annual and seasonal planning rhythm, including planning forums, inputs, working sessions, readiness reviews, decision logs and senior stakeholder updates.
* Ensure the plan balances long-term brand building with traffic and commercial priorities, with clear roles across Brand Marketing, Volume Collaborations, Brand Heat and Performance Marketing.
* Maintain a single source of truth across planning documents, calendars, milestones, assumptions, ownership and dependencies, surfacing gaps, overlaps and risks early.
* Use performance evidence, customer insight, product priorities, market context and previous learnings to improve future plans and recommendations.

2. Market Planning, Calendars & “Fit to Win”

* Act as the day-to-day Brand Planning point of contact for local market marketing teams, building a consistent two-way planning rhythm between central and local teams.
* Own the global market marketing calendar, bringing together global campaigns, locally relevant moments, product availability, adaptable assets, media support, market-led activations and key dependencies.
* Lead the process to understand each priority market’s “Fit to Win”: the customer, commercial, cultural, media and executional needs required for activity to succeed locally.
* Ensure market needs are considered early enough to shape the central plan, rather than being managed only at handover, while maintaining clear global priorities and guardrails.
* Drive bilateral alignment on where markets will amplify global activity, where localisation is required, where locally led activity is more appropriate, and what support, ownership and funding are needed.
* Create clear market handovers and participation views, escalating unresolved trade-offs and ensuring final decisions are reflected in one integrated global plan.

3. Communications Model & Channel Integration

* Drive the ASOS communications model, translating brand objectives and audience priorities into clear roles for paid, owned and earned channels across campaigns and always-on activity.
* Partner with Brand Strategy, Consumer Insight, Performance Marketing, Media, Social, PR, Talent, CRM, Homepage/App, Search and other channel teams to define how channels work together across the customer journey.
* Establish practical planning principles for channel role, audience, message, format, timing, sequencing, weighting and investment, ensuring these are applied consistently in annual and seasonal plans.
* Use effectiveness evidence and channel learnings to evolve the communications model, resolve duplication or gaps, and strengthen the connection between reach, consideration, traffic and commercial outcomes.
* Drive adoption of the model through clear tools, playbooks, forums and governance, ensuring it becomes a working planning framework rather than a standalone strategy document.

4. Strategy-to-Execution Handover & GTM Governance

* Own the planning handover from strategic direction into executable GTM plans, making sure teams understand the objective, role of the moment, audience, market implications, channel parameters, investment guardrails and measures of success.
* Partner with Brand Project Management and execution leads to translate the integrated plan into workstreams, critical paths, owners, milestones and dependencies without taking ownership of campaign creative briefing.
* Create clear governance across planning and execution, including who decides, who contributes, when decisions are required and how changes to scope, timing or investment are managed.
* Monitor readiness against the agreed plan, identify misalignment or delivery risk early, facilitate resolution and escalate material decisions to the Global Brand Planning Lead.
* Connect Brand, Product, Commercial, Creative, Media, channels, agencies and markets around one plan, reducing duplicated planning and fragmented handovers.
* Codify and continuously improve the Brand Planning playbook, including planning processes, roles, rituals, templates, decision rights and best practice.

5. Effectiveness, Reporting Oversight & Feed-Forward

* Ensure the reporting and effectiveness agenda is anchored to the priorities, KPIs and decisions set through the annual and seasonal planning process.
* Support with senior direction and quality assurance across weekly performance reporting, campaign PCAs, monthly GTM learnings, benchmarks and longer-term brand performance reviews.
* Challenge reporting to move beyond data collation, ensuring outputs explain what happened, why it matters, what should change and how learning will feed into future plans.
* Partner with analysts, channel teams, Paid Media and agencies to align performance narratives, caveats, implications and recommendations before senior review.
* Use cross-campaign and cross-season learning to recommend changes to phasing, channel roles, market choices, investment and ways of working.

6. Stakeholder, Agency & Team Leadership

* Build trusted relationships across senior stakeholders and working teams, using influence and facilitation to create clarity, resolve competing priorities and drive decisions.
* Lead day-to-day planning coordination with relevant agency partners, ensuring their strategic, media and effectiveness inputs are integrated into ASOS planning and delivered to agreed standards.
* Provide senior planning direction, coaching and constructive challenge to analysts within the Brand Planning & Reporting team, helping strengthen their judgement, ownership and connection between reporting and planning.
* Represent Brand Planning & Reporting in cross-functional forums with a clear view of the plan, performance, dependencies, decisions and implications.
* Create a proactive, transparent and accountable culture in which teams know what is required, by when, and how their contribution shapes the wider plan.

## Qualifications

Who We Are Looking For

* Strong experience in integrated brand planning, GTM planning, marketing strategy, communications planning or marketing operations within a complex consumer, fashion, retail, ecommerce or agency environment.
* Proven ability to translate strategy into annual and seasonal plans that connect objectives, audiences, product, channels, markets, investment and measurable outcomes.
* Experience partnering with local markets or regional marketing teams and balancing global consistency with local relevance and commercial need.
* Strong understanding of communications planning across paid, owned and earned channels, with the ability to define channel roles and connect activity across the customer journey.
* Experience leading complex cross-functional planning processes, establishing governance, managing dependencies and moving senior stakeholders towards clear decisions.
* Commercially aware and insight-led, with the judgement to use customer, brand, media and performance evidence to shape planning choices.
* Comfortable providing senior oversight of reporting and effectiveness, translating performance into focused implications and recommendations without needing to be the primary hands-on analyst.
* Excellent stakeholder management, facilitation and communication skills, with confidence operating across strategic and operational levels.
* Highly organised and proactive, able to create structure in ambiguity, manage competing priorities and maintain momentum in a fast-paced environment.
* A collaborative leadership style, with experience coaching or directing more junior team members and raising the quality of shared outputs.

Nice To Have

* Experience in fashion, retail, ecommerce or a global consumer brand.
* Experience developing or embedding a communications model, integrated channel framework or marketing playbook.
* Experience working with multiple international markets and creating global-to-local planning processes.
* Experience with brand and campaign effectiveness frameworks, PCAs, GTM reporting, media planning or investment principles.
* Experience partnering with media, creative or strategic agencies and managing their inputs across an integrated planning cycle.
* Experience working across both brand-building and performance marketing priorities.

# Strategic Alliance Manager - DACH Region

London, United Kingdom

### What You'll Do

The mission of the Strategic Alliances team is to create long-term, multi-dimensional partnerships that drive mutual revenue to Avalara and our partners, ensuring client success.  
  
The Strategic Alliance Manager - DACH is responsible for identifying, analysing, signing, and managing partnerships across the DACH region (Germany, Austria, and Switzerland) that will help Avalara achieve its growth objectives and generate new client value.  
  
This position forms deep relationships with external partners at all levels of their organisation, acts as the primary point of contact for those partnerships, and serves as the bridge between DACH-based partners and Avalara's Sales, Marketing, and wider business units.  
  
The primary focus of this role is on SAP System Integrators and their surrounding ecosystem, including implementation partners, consulting firms, and adjacent technology providers operating in the DACH market. The role is not limited to SAP, and the right candidate will bring the commercial curiosity and network to identify and develop high-value partnerships wherever the opportunity exists.  
  
Success in this role is measured by the quality and volume of partner-sourced pipeline generated across DACH. This is not a direct sales role: the Alliance Manager's responsibility is to build the partner relationships and ecosystem activity that surface and qualify new opportunities, which are then handed off to Avalara's sales teams to progress and close. The ability to work closely and productively with sales colleagues is therefore as important as the ability to manage partner relationships.  
  
This is a remote role based in the UK, with frequent travel across the DACH region and regular travel to Avalara offices and partner events across EMEA.

### What Your Responsibilities Will Be

* Own the DACH partner ecosystem: recruit, develop, and manage partnerships across the region with a primary focus on SAP System Integrators, underpinned by a structured territory plan that identifies the highest-value opportunities and a clear approach to engagement and pipeline generation
* Build trusted relationships at all levels of partner organisations, from delivery and sales teams through to senior leadership and C-Suite contacts, creating executive alignment on shared goals, joint initiatives, and commercial commitments
* Enable and activate partner teams: train and develop partners on transaction tax, Avalara's product portfolio, and the DACH compliance landscape, then convert that knowledge into qualified, partner-sourced pipeline that is handed off to Avalara's sales teams
* Work closely and continuously with Avalara's DACH and EMEA sales teams to ensure referrals flow efficiently, attribution is accurate, and partners receive timely updates on opportunity progress and outcomes
* Lead joint business planning and conduct Quarterly Business Reviews with key partners, setting shared revenue targets, agreeing co-marketing activity, and tracking performance against plan
* Plan and execute co-marketing activity across DACH with support from Partner Marketing, including events, webinars, co-branded campaigns, and thought leadership that drives engagement and referral volume
* Use tools to maintain data accuracy, analyse partner and pipeline performance, inform forecasting, and drive day-to-day efficiency across the role
* Provide market intelligence on DACH-specific dynamics, competitor activity, and commercial trends, and manage partner enquiries relating to sales, product, and commissions

### What You’ll Need To Be Successful

* Degree-level education or equivalent professional experience
* Fluent in German and English to a professional business standard; this is a firm requirement for the role
* Demonstrable success in partner, channel, or alliance management in the technology sector, with a strong track record in the DACH market; direct experience within the SAP ecosystem (SIs, consultancies, or ISV partners) is strongly preferred
* Proven ability to build relationships that generate qualified pipeline and measurable commercial outcomes, with the commercial instinct and presence to engage effectively at C-Suite level on both sides of a partnership
* Self-starting and entrepreneurial, with the confidence to take full ownership of a territory, set priorities independently, and contribute actively to co-marketing programmes
* Culturally fluent in DACH business environments, with an understanding of the relationship dynamics, communication styles, and professional norms that underpin trust in German-speaking markets
* Proficient with Salesforce and the Microsoft Office Suite; comfortable using AI tools to enhance productivity and partner communications; Slack, Power BI, & Crossbeam experience a plus
* Collaborative, curious, and accountable, with the humility to listen, the urgency to act, and the adaptability to thrive in a fast-moving, cross-functional organisation
* Additional European languages are an advantage

### Avalara is an AI-first Company

AI is embedded in our workflows, decision-making, and products.  Success here requires embracing AI as an essential capability.

* You’ll bring experience using AI and AI-related technologies, ready to thrive here.
* You’ll apply AI every day to business challenges - improving efficiency, contributing solutions, and driving results for your team, our company, and our customers.
* You’ll grow with AI by staying curious about new trends and best practices, and by sharing what you learn so others can benefit too.

### How We’ll Take Care Of You

Total Rewards 

In addition to a great compensation package, paid time off, and paid parental leave, many Avalara employees are eligible for bonuses. 

Health & Wellness   
Benefits vary by location but generally include private medical, life, and disability insurance. 

Inclusive culture and diversity   
Avalara strongly supports diversity, equity, and inclusion, and is committed to integrating them into our business practices and our organizational culture. We also have a total of 8 employee-run resource groups, each with senior leadership and exec sponsorship. 

### What You Need To Know About Avalara

We’re defining the relationship between tax and tech.

We’ve already built an industry-leading cloud compliance platform, processing over 54 billion customer API calls and over 6.6 million tax returns a year. Our growth is real - we're a billion dollar business - and we’re not slowing down until we’ve achieved our mission - to be part of every transaction in the world.

We’re bright, innovative, and disruptive, like the orange we love to wear. It captures our quirky spirit and optimistic mindset. It shows off the culture we’ve designed, that empowers our people to win. We’ve been different from day one. Join us, and your career will be too.

The Bank of England is the UK's central bank. Our mission is to deliver monetary and financial stability for the British people.

The Bank of England is a diverse organisation. Each of its 5,000-plus people are committed to public service and dedicated to promoting the good of the people of the United Kingdom by maintaining monetary and financial stability.

Within the Bank, the Prudential Regulation Authority (PRA) is the UK’s prudential regulator of banks and insurance companies, focused on promoting firms’ safety and soundness, protecting insurance policyholders, facilitating effective competition and supporting the long-term growth and competitiveness of the UK economy.

**Directorate Overview**

Prudential Policy Directorate (PPD) is responsible for designing, negotiating internationally and implementing effective prudential regulation. Through this work, PPD seeks to reduce systemic risk, promote the safety and soundness of PRA-regulated firms, and ensure appropriate protection for insurance policyholders. Importantly it seeks to achieve this whilst supporting effective competition within the UK financial sector, while contributing to the UK's international competitiveness and growth.

PPD supports both the Prudential Regulation Committee and Financial Policy Committee in fulfilling their objectives.

**Job Description**

The Executive Director (ED), PPD is a highly visible and influential leadership role within the PRA, the wider Bank and externally (both in the UK and internationally). The role holder is responsible for leading a large, multidisciplinary policy function comprising over 250 staff, working across five divisions: Banking Capital Policy; Prudential Framework; Governance, Accounting, Resilience and Data; Insurance Policy, and Strategy and Policy Approach. The role holder sets the strategic direction for the directorate and ensures the delivery of high-quality prudential policymaking and the maintenance of the PRA’s Rulebook - the PRA’s central repository of prudential requirements and guidance for firms it regulates - in a way that supports the PRA's statutory objectives. The role holder also works closely with an extensive set of senior stakeholders across the Bank, government, international institutions and industry.

The ED reports to the Deputy Governor and CEO for the PRA, Katharine Braddick.

The firm works across energy and resources, financial services, government and public sector, consumer products and retail, pharmaceuticals and life sciences, manufacturing, and technology, media and telecoms, with capabilities spanning strategy, transformation and operational excellence – all powered by advanced technology, data, AI and digital innovation.

Clients value Baringa’s collaborative approach and the way its teams integrate seamlessly – all working with a shared understanding of what matters most. The firm is known for its kind, curious experts who listen closely and care deeply about client success as they help clients transform energy markets, modernise financial platforms, expand telecoms and digital networks through advanced data analytics, enable digital services in government, and unlock growth in consumer sectors.

Certified as a *Great Place to Work* around the world, Baringa has been recognised by the *Financial Times* in 22 categories of its UK Leading Management Consultants rankings, and by *Forbes* for four consecutive years as one of the World’s Best Management Consulting Firms.

## Our Customer practice are looking for an experienced Senior Consultant or Manager to join the team.

Our Customer team is hiring a motivated and talented individual, from Senior Consultants to Manager, to help our clients evolve how they serve their customers in a world increasingly shaped by AI. From rethinking the end-to-end customer journey through to embedding AI into day-to-day operations, we help clients turn ambition into something that actually works. 

### What you will be doing

You’ll work side-by-side with clients to identify and drive improves in how customer service operates - understanding demand, journeys and pain points, and identifying where AI can genuinely add value to improve customer outcomes and efficiency. 

You’ll be designing and delivering real change - not just strategy on paper - getting into the detail of how contact centres run today, and what it takes to make improvement stick. 

You will be particularly focused on: 

* **Reimagining customer service:**improving how contact centres operate - from demand management and journeys through to channel mix, automation and service design
* **Applying AI in customer environments:** identifying and shaping where AI can add value across voice and digital channels (e.g. IVR, chat, agent assist), with a clear view on what will drive real operational impact
* **Hands-on end-to-end delivery:** working across the lifecycle from strategy through to design and implementation - shaping roadmaps, standing up pilots and supporting real-world delivery
* **Owning delivery:** leading workstreams or small pods - setting direction, driving progress and being accountable for outcomes
* **Working as one team with clients:** leading workshops and aligning stakeholders across Product, Tech and Operations to move delivery forward at pace
* **Supporting growth:**contributing to proposals and helping shape new opportunities across customer and AI
* **Supporting others:** coaching junior team members and acting as a go-to within your area

### Your skills and experience

We’re looking for people with strong foundations in customer and contact centre transformation, who bring a clear, practical perspective on how AI can be applied to improve service. 

* **Strong grounding in customer contact operations:** deep understanding of how contact centres run day-to-day across voice and digital channels (sales, service, complaints), including demand drivers, KPIs and operational challenges
* **Applied understanding of AI in service environments:** able to identify, shape and prioritise AI use cases (e.g. IVR automation, chatbots, agent assist), with a clear view on feasibility, value and operational impact
* **Experience with customer and AI technologies:**understanding of the platforms that enable modern contact centres and AI capabilities, with a practical view of what works in the real world
* **Structured thinking and clear point of view:**able to frame problems, form recommendations and communicate clearly to senior stakeholders
* **Strong client delivery:** comfortable building high-quality outputs (strategies, roadmaps, business cases) and working at pace in delivery environments
* **Data-driven decision making:** using data and insight to identify opportunities, prioritise effectively and guide decisions
* **Building value cases and buy-in:** able to articulate clear value and bring stakeholders with you to support change
* **Drive and ownership:** comfortable navigating ambiguity, structuring problems and taking responsibility for outcomes
* **Collaboration and stakeholder management:**confident working across Product, Technology and Operations, bridging technical and non-technical teams
* **Curiosity for how AI is evolving:** keeps up to date with the space and brings practical insight into client work

 

## What a career at Baringa will give you

### Putting People First.

### Baringa is a People First company and wellbeing is at the forefront of our culture. We recognise the importance of work-life balance and flexible working and provide our staff amazing benefits. Some of these benefits include:

## Our Energy & Resources - Asset Management practice are looking for Manager with a solid operational technology (OT) background to join the team.

Our Asset & Operations Excellence teams help energy, utilities and industrial clients get more from their physical assets – improving safety, reliability, availability and whole-life cost across the asset lifecycle. We combine deep asset management and engineering expertise with modern enterprise asset management technology and data to help clients move from reactive maintenance to intelligent, insight-led asset management.

Operational technology sits at the heart of this. The control systems, telemetry and operational data that run our clients’ networks and plant are increasingly the foundation for predictive maintenance, remote operations and AI-enabled decision making, and they must be integrated with core IT and protected against a growing cyber threat. This role is for someone with hands-on OT experience who wants to apply it in a consulting environment, helping clients connect their operational systems and data to better asset outcomes.

### What you will be doing

* You’ll work as part of client teams delivering asset management and operational improvement programmes for asset-intensive clients across energy, utilities and major infrastructure, contributing to current-state assessments, operating model design and implementation, with a particular focus on the OT and control systems landscape.
* You’ll help assess clients’ OT estates, including SCADA, DCS, PLC/RTU, telemetry, data historians and condition monitoring systems, gathering and analysing information and contributing to recommendations and roadmaps.
* You’ll support the design of integrations and data flows between OT systems and EAM / CMMS platforms such as IBM Maximo, ERP and analytics platforms, helping operational data drive condition-based and predictive maintenance.
* You’ll contribute to OT resilience work, for example assessing controls against industry frameworks and helping document governance, change control, data ownership (RACI) and support models for critical systems.
* You’ll help explore and test how operational data, industrial IoT, digital twins and AI can improve asset performance, safety and availability, including developing use cases and supporting proofs of concept.
* You’ll support the handover of engineering and OT data from capital projects into operations, helping ensure new and upgraded assets go live with trusted data and integrated systems.
* You’ll own discrete pieces of analysis and deliverables, help run workshops and interviews with client stakeholders, and build strong day-to-day working relationships with client teams.
* You’ll support & contribute to proposals and thought leadership, and help grow our OT and asset operations propositions within a steadily growing practice.

### Your skills and experience

* You’ve built early-to-mid career experience in operational technology, control systems or industrial automation within an asset-intensive sector – energy, utilities, oil and gas, water, manufacturing or similar – whether in industry, with a system integrator or OEM, or in consulting.
* You’ve practical, hands-on experience with OT technologies such as SCADA, DCS, PLC/RTU or data historians (for example AVEVA PI), and a working understanding of industrial protocols (for example OPC UA, Modbus or DNP3) and OT network architectures such as the Purdue model.
* You understand how OT data connects to the wider technology landscape, such as EAM / CMMS platforms like IBM Maximo, ERP and analytics platforms. Maximo experience is a bonus but not essential.
* You’ve an interest in asset management and maintenance and reliability principles, such as condition-based monitoring; exposure to ISO 55000 is helpful but not required.
* You’ve contributed to change or improvement projects, whether in consulting, industry or a major programme, and are confident owning your own deliverables, managing your time across tasks and turning analysis into clear, practical recommendations.
* You’ve strong analytical, written and verbal communication skills, and you’re comfortable working with client stakeholders from control room engineers and operations managers through to IT and digital teams.
* You’re curious about how emerging technologies and Artificial Intelligence (AI) are changing OT and asset operations; any experience with AI, IIoT or advanced analytics solutions is a plus.
* You’re eager to learn and grow in a consulting environment and interested in the energy transition.

We are looking for an experienced **Paid Media Manager (B2B SaaS)** to join our Marketing team on a contractor basis and take end-to-end ownership of Basware's global paid media channels during a maternity cover period.

This is a hands-on, operationally focused role responsible for planning, executing and optimising paid media activity across LinkedIn and a wider mix of digital media partners and channels. The role will ensure activity is audience-led, aligned to Basware's Ideal Customer Profile and contributes to lead, MQL, pipeline and growth targets across 11 global markets.

You will manage campaigns throughout their full lifecycle, from briefing, audience development and creative production through to launch, budget management, optimisation and reporting. You will also manage relationships with external media vendors, coordinating proposals and local and regional needs, and ensure campaigns are delivered on time, on brand, on brief and on budget.

The successful candidate will combine strong paid media expertise with excellent project management, copywriting and analytical skills. They must be comfortable working independently in the detail while collaborating across global Campaigns, Regional Marketing, Content, Brand, Marketing Operations and Sales.

They will take a proactive approach to using AI and emerging paid media technologies to improve the speed, efficiency and effectiveness of campaign delivery, creative development, optimisation and reporting, while keeping up to date with evolving platform capabilities and industry best practice.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Paid Media Campaign Management & Execution**

* Own the day-to-day management of Basware's global paid media activity, with a particular focus on LinkedIn Campaign Manager, including campaign setup and delivery, budget management and pacing, performance monitoring and optimisation, audience targeting, creative development and refreshes, tracking and reporting.
* Build, launch and manage campaigns with other advertising platforms and vendors, including campaign structure, audience setup, creative implementation, links, tracking and testing.
* Monitor live activity and identify opportunities to improve targeting, creative, budget allocation and overall campaign performance.
* Use AI-assisted platform capabilities, including LinkedIn Accelerate where appropriate, to support campaign creation, audience development, bidding and optimisation, while maintaining clear human oversight and agreed brand and budget controls.
* Ensure campaigns support Basware's global strategy, Ideal Customer Profile and relevant regional market requirements.
* Manage paid social, display, retargeting, affiliate, programmatic, intent display and other relevant digital media opportunities as required.

**2. Budget, Tracking & Governance**

* Manage daily campaign spend and pacing against agreed monthly and quarterly budgets, identifying risks and recommending reallocations based on performance and business priorities.
* Maintain accurate campaign, budget and performance records, including planned and actual spend, budget variance, and records of live, paused and newly launched creative.
* Complete monthly reconciliation processes, including platform invoices, budget records, invoice submission, purchase orders and necessary financial approvals.
* Build and maintain tracking links, naming conventions, GTM records, campaign documentation, creative libraries and screenshot decks, in line with agreed governance processes.

**3. Campaign Content & Creative**

* Manage the paid media briefing and production process, from initial campaign requirement through to launch.
* Translate complex content, including reports, whitepapers and campaign materials, into clear and engaging advertising messages.
* Develop paid media copy and messaging using campaign assets, audience insights and core value propositions, working with in-house Brand, Design and Content teams.
* Use AI tools to accelerate campaign and creative refreshes, develop and test copy variations, support localisation and adapt messaging for different audiences and markets, while ensuring all outputs are reviewed for accuracy, quality and brand alignment.
* Support the development of local-language advertising, coordinating translation and in-market review where required.

**4. Reporting, Optimisation & Performance Insight**

* Work closely with Marketing Operations to ensure external platform data and reporting are aligned with internal processes and the wider basware.com customer journey, and to identify opportunities to streamline and automate reporting.
* Use first-party account, contact and intent data, supported by AI where appropriate, to build and refresh audience segments, prioritise in-market accounts, develop more segmented approaches and improve the effectiveness of media investment.

* Continuously review paid media performance and identify opportunities to improve audience targeting, engagement, conversion and media efficiency, providing updates on risks and optimisation priorities.
* Use AI-assisted analysis and reporting to identify performance trends, anomalies, risks and optimisation opportunities more quickly, turning campaign data into clear, actionable recommendations rather than reporting numbers alone.
* Develop a structured testing plan covering new channels, campaign formats, audiences, creative approaches and messaging, and apply learnings consistently across campaigns and markets rather than treating tests as isolated activities.

**5. Vendor & Stakeholder Management**

* Manage relationships with external media vendors, publications and platform partners across the full campaign lifecycle, including proposal evaluation, briefing, creative delivery, tracking, execution and performance reporting.
* Manage the operational administration required for external media activity, including purchase orders, approvals, invoice coordination, vendor onboarding and campaign documentation.
* Partner closely with Global Campaigns, Regional Marketing, Proposition Marketing, Content, Brand, Marketing Operations, BDR and Sales teams to deliver a joined-up demand generation approach.
* Manage ad hoc regional and global requests, prioritising activity based on campaign objectives, available budget and expected impact, while communicating priorities, dependencies and next steps clearly.

At BioPhorum, you will work alongside leading experts and organisations across the global biopharmaceutical sector, helping to develop shared approaches to the challenges shaping advanced therapies.

About the Role  
  
Every Brompton bike is designed, engineered and handmade in Greenford. This programme puts you at the heart of the costs, decisions and data behind each one. You will also improve processes and data flows, using tools such as SQL, Power Query, Power Automate, ERPs and AI to simplify and automate work.

**What makes this role different**

* On the ground, not behind a screen: You will be based on site, close to the people who design, build and ship our bikes, and close to the decisions that shape them.
* Real impact on our products: Your questions and insights will influence how our products are developed and made. This is at the heart of what we do.
* A pivotal role with many teams: You will work with a variety of Operations and Product teams, as a key onsite finance business partner for colleagues up to Heads of department.
* Learn by doing: You will pick up finance by working on real questions, with the Operations Accountant and Operations Finance Analyst alongside you.
* A modern toolkit: You will use SQL, Power Query and Power Automate, and explore new technologies, to solve problems in creative ways.
* Strong foundations: You will learn why good process, reliable systems and clean data matter, and how to build and improve them.
* A clear route to a professional qualification: We fund and support your CIMA studies, with protected study time at the beginning.
* Direct mentoring: You will report to, and be mentored by, the Director of Finance for Operations & Product.
* A culture of doing more with less: We value frugality, resource efficiency and a genuine commitment to sustainability, and we look for people who enjoy finding smarter ways to work.

  

**Your development on the programme**

* Year one: You will study the CIMA Certificate in Business Accounting, supported by the company through an apprenticeship. Tuition is covered and you will have protected study time during working hours. You will apply what you learn straight away by supporting the Operations Accountant.
* After the Certificate: The company continues to support you towards the full CIMA qualification, with the aim of completing it within three years. Tuition is covered through the CIMA Finance Leadership Programme.
* Growing responsibility: You will take on more ownership and a wider business partnering role as you progress. Progression in pay and responsibility are part of the programme and linked to your progress with the qualification and your performance on the job over the years.

  

**Key responsibilities**

**Our finance partner on site**

* Be Finance’s visible, approachable partner for Operations and Product, building trusted relationships across the teams.
* Spend time on the shop floor, in the warehouse and with product teams to understand what is happening and how it affects costs.
* Connect teams with finance colleagues, bringing back the context behind the numbers and answering or directing finance questions.
* Gather key information for budgets, forecasts and projects, and explain costs clearly to non-finance colleagues.

  

**Supporting the monthly finance cycle**

Support the Operations Accountant with month-end, making sure the costs of building our bikes are recorded accurately and in the right period. You will take on more as your experience grows.

* Help record and understand the parts, consumables and labour that make up the cost of each bike.
* Review product parts lists, production activity and cost implications with the right teams.
* Investigate scrap, freight, duties, warranty claims and other cost movements to understand their causes and impact.
* Support stock checks and keep records of machinery, equipment and tooling accurate.

# Lead Application Security Engineer
