# Senior Grid Engineer – Power Systems & Compliance

* Full-time
* Business Units: TN – Project Delivery New Renewables

## Company Description

Statkraft is Europe's largest generator of renewable energy from hydro, wind and solar power. We have around 6,200 employees in 20 countries. We have been making clean energy possible for over 130 years, with unrivalled expertise in supplying the world with what it needs most. We envision a world that runs entirely on renewable energy.

As a Senior Grid Engineer – Power Systems & Compliance, you will support the technical delivery, grid integration and compliance of Statkraft’s renewable energy and grid services portfolio, including Battery Energy Storage Systems (BESS), synchronous condensers, solar PV, wind and hybrid/co-located projects.

Reporting to the Technical Manager – Grid Services UK, you will act as the day-to-day technical lead for assigned grid, power systems and compliance workstreams, working closely with project teams, consultants, OEMs, contractors and network operators.

## Job Description

* Lead and manage Grid Code and G99 compliance activities, translating connection and regulatory requirements into clear technical deliverables, compliance strategies and project programmes.
* Manage projects through power system studies, modelling, technical submissions, commissioning, compliance testing and final compliance acceptance, including EON, ION and FON processes where applicable.
* Define, coordinate and review power system study programmes, including load flow, fault level, reactive power, harmonics, power quality, stability, RMS, EMT and control interaction studies.
* Review and challenge consultant and OEM study methodologies, assumptions, models and results, assessing their impact on plant design, controls, commissioning and compliance.
* Manage technical engagement with NESO, Transmission Owners and DNOs, coordinating technical submissions, responses, evidence and compliance close-out activities.
* Define and review plant control and integration requirements, including PPC/MPPC, EMS, BESS and grid-forming controls, AVR systems, synchronous condenser controls and network operator interfaces.
* Support the wider technical ownership and integration of BESS and synchronous condenser projects, while leading grid connection, power system performance and compliance activities for wind and solar projects.
* Work closely with Project Managers and multidisciplinary engineering teams to identify and manage technical, programme and commercial risks, review designs and contractor submissions, and support procurement and tender evaluations.
* Provide technical leadership throughout design, construction and commissioning, assessing the compliance impact of design or equipment changes and supporting the resolution of complex technical issues.
* Provide clear, practical and commercially aware engineering recommendations, supporting project handover into operations and providing technical guidance and mentoring to other engineers.

## Qualifications

We are looking for an experienced power systems professional who combines strong technical knowledge with a pragmatic approach to project delivery and is confident challenging consultants, OEMs and contractors.

* Degree in Electrical Engineering, Power Systems Engineering or a related discipline, or equivalent relevant industry experience.
* Strong experience within transmission-connected generation, energy storage, grid support technologies or major distribution-connected projects, with experience of Grid Code, G99 and network compliance.
* Strong understanding of the GB Grid Code, with experience managing projects through power system studies, commissioning, compliance testing and final compliance acceptance.
* Demonstrable experience specifying, managing and reviewing power system studies and models, with the technical capability to challenge methodologies, assumptions, results and recommendations.
* Strong knowledge of voltage and reactive power control, frequency response, fault ride-through, fault levels, system stability, harmonics and power quality.
* Experience managing technical interfaces between consultants, OEMs, EPC contractors and network operators, alongside a good understanding of HV substations, transformers, protection, metering and control systems.
* Experience with one or more relevant technologies, including BESS, synchronous condensers, wind, solar PV or converter-based generation; hybrid/co-located and grid-forming BESS experience would be advantageous.
* Experience with RMS and EMT models and tools such as PowerFactory, PSCAD, PSS®E or equivalent is desirable, although hands-on modelling expertise is not essential.
* Knowledge or experience of NESO and DNO compliance processes, EON/ION/FON, UK standards and 132 kV, 275 kV and/or 400 kV connections would be advantageous.
* Strong technical communication, stakeholder management and decision-making skills, with the confidence to work independently, challenge technical assumptions and escalate significant issues when required; Chartered Engineer status or progress towards CEng would be advantageous.

## Additional Information

A career with Statkraft is a career filled with purpose – meaning that every employee is not just making a living, they are making a real difference to the planet, our communities, and the future. With us, you’ll shape a career that is truly forward-facing with many amazing opportunities and offerings to match. This includes:

* An opportunity to work with renewable energy and contribute to a low emission society
* Professional and personal development in an exciting global company
* A working environment characterized by competence, responsibility, innovation and a strong commercial culture
* A diverse workplace with regards to gender, age and cultural background
* Competitive terms of employment and benefit schemes
* Career and learning opportunities at various levels of the organisation
* The chance to grow your career alongside a truly global network of experts, leaders, specialists and graduates from different countries and background
* Hybrid working

Statkraft manages critical infrastructure and services in several countries. The applicant must be eligible for security clearance and authorisation.

# Chief of Staff to the CEO

## Partner with sunday’s CEO to turn big priorities into action, shape company strategy and lead high-impact projects as the business scales across the US and Europe.

#### **👋 About Us**

sunday is building the fastest, simplest way to pay in restaurants. With a quick scan of a QR code, diners can pay, tip, and leave in about 10 seconds. We believe great products should feel obvious, not complicated, and we focus relentlessly on keeping things **simple** while earning **trust** from restaurants and guests at every interaction. Today, sunday powers payments in thousands of restaurants across the US, UK, and France, helping operators turn tables faster, increase tips, and unlock valuable insights. We push ourselves to go **beyond** what’s expected, building with ownership, moving fast, and scaling with ambition as we tackle our biggest growth opportunity in the US.

#### **About the Role**

As Chief of Staff to the CEO, you are Victor Lugger's executor, thought partner, and proxy. Victor is sunday's co-founder and CEO, and you work alongside him in London.

You turn the CEO's priorities into results across the company. One day that means preparing an investor Q&A; the next it means stress-testing the product roadmap, pressure-testing sales quotas, or building the content for a leadership offsite. You represent Victor in rooms he can't be in, and you make sure decisions taken there are executed.

The range is wide by design: from the logistics that protect the CEO's time, all the way up to launching a new product line.

Why this role stands out:

* You work directly with a serial founder on the topics that move sunday's business, with no layers in between
* You see the whole company: product, sales, operations, finance, and fundraising
* You join at a moment of scale, when the operating rhythm of the company is being built

Right to work in the UK required.  
Join early, grow fast, and shape the journey!

#### **Key Responsibilities**

* **You are the CEO's thought partner.** You help Victor prioritise, frame trade-offs, and prepare for high-stakes calls. You build the analyses behind his decisions on adoption, product bets, and business performance.
* **You run the company operating system.** You own the cadence of leadership forums, OKR setting and tracking, and innovation cycles: agendas, pre-reads, decision logs, and follow-through.
* **You act as Victor's proxy.** You represent him in meetings and workstreams he can't attend, hold owners accountable, and bring back what he needs to know.
* **You prepare investor and board materials.** You draft investor Q&A and board pre-reads, and you own the narrative and the numbers behind them.
* **You pressure-test the plan.** You challenge the product roadmap and sales quotas with data, and flag risks before they become surprises.
* **You launch what's next.** You lead high-priority projects across Product, Sales, Operations, and Finance from idea to launch, up to a new product line.
* **You design leadership offsites.** You build the content, run the logistics, and turn the outcomes into an action plan with owners and dates.
* **You protect the CEO's time.** You handle the logistics that keep Victor focused on the few topics that matter most.

#### **About You**

Must-haves:

* You have 2–5 years of experience at a fast-growing startup, a top-tier strategy consulting firm, or in investment banking / private equity
* You're sharply analytical: you turn messy data and ambiguous questions into a clear recommendation
* You're entrepreneurial: you've built something, owned an outcome end to end, or thrived without a playbook
* You have high emotional intelligence: you build trust fast, read the room, and work well with senior leaders
* You're ego-free and resilient: you take direct, high-tempo feedback in stride and stay focused on the outcome
* You write and speak with clarity and punch in English
* You're based in London and able to work in person with the CEO

Nice-to-haves:

* You've worked in fintech, payments, SaaS, or hospitality
* You've prepared fundraising or board materials
* You've worked across European and US teams
* You speak French

You'll thrive at sunday if you:

* Don't wait for permission: you launch, build, fail, and try again
* Move from discussion to action in the same day
* Apply 80/20 thinking: you know what matters and make sharp trade-offs
* Are comfortable with intensity: this role follows the CEO's pace, which includes evenings and weekends when the business needs it
* Bring positive energy that lifts everyone around you

#### **What we Offer**

* Salary
* Stock Options
* A great office in the heart of London with a balance of in-person and remote work
* Free Vacation Policy
* 100% Employer-Covered Health Insurance

#### **🐾** Steps in our Recruitment Process

* Share your story: application with resume
* Let's get to know each other through a screening interview
* Meet with the hiring manager
* Impress your future colleagues with a case study
* Meet with Victor
* Reference Checks (3 most recent managers)
* Offer: we want you

Thank you for taking the time to apply, and looking forward to getting to know you!

## **About Supabase**

Supabase is the Postgres development platform, built by developers for developers. We provide a complete backend solution including Database, Auth, Storage, Edge Functions, Realtime, and Vector Search. All services are deeply integrated and designed for growth.

## **About the Role**

We're hiring a Product Manager for Supabase Auth. You'll own the surface area that developers use to authenticate and authorize their end users and manage identity in their apps: email, phone and social login, passkeys and MFA, enterprise SSO, the OAuth 2.1 server, auth hooks, and support for organizations and multi-tenant applications.

You'll work closely with the Auth engineering team and with partners across Product Management, Security, Design and GTM.

This role is ideal for someone who’s excited about building tools for millions of developers and who has a strong understanding of *existing and emerging* authentication practices and protocols.

## What You’ll Be Responsible For

* **You'll collaborate with customers of all sizes and expertise levels.** Indie developers shipping a side project, startups choosing their first auth stack, SaaS teams designing multi-tenant access, and enterprises in security review.
* **You'll own the problem statements and solution rationale behind the Auth roadmap.** This means working with Engineering and Design to shape *how* Supabase crafts the developer experience for the problems you’ve prioritized solving.
* **You'll define how Auth works for AI agents on Supabase**: agents that sign users up, act on their behalf, and call APIs.
* **You'll use data to understand how Supabase developers are using Auth features**: where they succeed, where they get stuck, and what to tackle first.
* **You'll keep Engineering, Design and GTM aligned.** You'll own the plan of record for what's coming, why, and in what order.

## **You Might Be a Good Fit If You**

### **Must have**

* **5+ years of Product Management experience on developer tools, or are an ex-founder with equivalent depth.** You're comfortable commenting on an architecture doc, following a design discussion, and advocating for the user when trade-offs are required.
* **Have shipped standards-based auth or identity products.** You've owned OAuth/OIDC, SAML, SCIM, sessions or token design, and you know from experience where each one breaks for customers.
* **Work comfortably with corporate buyers and with developers.** You can work through a CISO's security review and an indie developer's bug report in the same week. You have intuition on which enterprise asks are real value-adding requirements and which are checkbox items.
* **Are comfortable with Postgres and familiar with row-level security.**
* **Work async by default.** Supabase is fully remote. You make decisions in writing and move work forward without meetings.

### Strong signal

* Owned auth or identity inside an integrated cloud platform.
* Ran an organizations, tenancy, or SSO+SCIM launch from start to finish.
* Designed auth for agents or other automated systems: OAuth for MCP clients, machine-to-machine credentials, scoped tokens.
* Shipped something using Supabase.

### **What We Offer**

* **Fully Remote**

  We hire globally. We believe you can do your best work from anywhere. There are no Supabase offices, but we provide a WeWork membership or co-working allowance you can use anywhere in the world.

## **About the Role**

We are looking for a **Head of AI Operations** to own how Supabase works.

Supabase is building an AI-native internal operating system: a common way of working across the company where AI carries a meaningful share of the operational load rather than sitting alongside it as an assistant. We are standing up a new central team to build those systems, enable the teams, and embed AI operations throughout the organization. This is the role that runs it.

You will own the maturity model teams are assessed against, the standards that define how work happens here, and the operating cadence, under one design rule: **every recurring meeting has to justify why an automated report cannot replace it**. You will lead a small team of senior individual contributors, one building the platform and one running enablement.

The premise is that process encoded as agents scales where process enforced by people does not. Your job is to prove that is a repeatable pattern rather than an anomaly, across teams you have no authority over.

We are fully remote and async. The document is the enforcement mechanism here, which means the standards themselves are your deliverable.

## **What You'll Be Responsible For**

In this role, you'll:

* **Own the maturity model end to end:** The rubric, the scoring method, the evidence standard, and the appeals path. Every team ends up with a published assessment and a written plan to its next level.
* **Run assessments and commitments:** Conduct assessments with department heads yourself, landing them as commitments with named owners and dates rather than opinions.
* **Own the standards layer:** Define how work gets tracked, decisions get proposed and resolved, teams migrate onto shared tooling, and stale documentation gets retired. Standards ship as documents teams follow without being chased.
* **Fix the decision process:** Ensure written proposals reach resolution instead of accumulating unresolved by defining stages, exit criteria, and closing mechanisms.
* **Run the operating cadence:** Lead automated weekly reporting, a regular blockers-and-decisions forum, a monthly leadership review, and a quarterly board-level format. Delete meetings a report could replace.
* **Manage rollouts:** Execute private assessments first so leads see only their own and have time to move, followed by a pre-committed public transparency date.
* **Wire standards into onboarding:** Ensure every cohort arrives pre-trained rather than inheriting nearby habits.
* **Build and direct the team:** Hire, grow, review, and direct two senior individual contributors (platform and enablement) without doing their work for them.
* **Measure and publish outcomes:** Measure and publish whether the thesis holds by tracking how much coordination work agents absorb versus what a human program office would cost.

## **How You'll Think**

### **Recursive Thinking**

Every standard you write should be the input to something that enforces it, and every enforcement mechanism should produce the evidence that grades it. When you write the rule that work must carry a current status, you are not finished until a report finds the stale items and tells their owners without you in the loop. The same applies to your own function: the team you build gets assessed by the model you own, published next to everyone else's, and you should want that.

### **Inversion Thinking**

The default outcome for a company-wide standard is that teams politely ignore it. So the first question about any standard is not "is this correct" but "what will make people route around this," and the design follows from that answer. Same for meetings: rather than asking what a new sync would accomplish, ask what report would make it unnecessary and build the report. Same for the public transparency date: it gets committed before anyone has a score to defend, because afterwards the lobbying is rational.

### **AI-Native Execution**

You direct agents rather than doing the work by hand, and you can tell whether the direction was any good. That means reading an agent workflow definition and knowing the procedure is too broad, reading a data model and challenging the metric behind it, reading a pull request from your own team and sending it back. Your working artifacts are files in version control that agents can read, not chat transcripts. You will not build the platform. You will be the person who says whether what got built is right.

* Develop compelling campaign concepts and creative platforms from briefs, insights and strategy.

* Create ideas that flex across channels (social, digital, web, film, print, experiential).

* Present creative thinking clearly and confidently internally (and to clients where appropriate).

**Copywriting (Copywriter)**

* Write engaging, on-brand copy across: social, paid ads, landing pages, web copy, scripts, headlines, OOH/print, email and campaign messaging.

* Adapt tone of voice across audiences (B2B and B2C) while maintaining consistency and clarity.

* Support development of messaging frameworks, taglines, product/value propositions and content plans.

* Proofread and ensure copy is accurate, compliant and aligned to brand guidelines.

**Design (Art Director)**

* Design campaign assets across digital and print (social toolkits, display ads, presentations, brand assets, infographics, event collateral, etc.).

* Create and evolve templates/toolkits for scalable, multi-market campaign delivery.

* Prepare artwork for production and ensure files are delivered correctly.

* Work closely with client teams, project management and production to manage priorities and hit deadlines.

* Collaborate with motion/video/web specialists where needed; hand over assets cleanly and clearly.

* Participate in creative reviews, respond to feedback constructively, and iterate quickly.

* Stay curious about culture, platforms and emerging formats; bring fresh ideas to the studio.

* Proven experience as a creative within an agency or in-house team, with a strong portfolio.

* Ability to generate campaign ideas as well as execute high-quality day-to-day creative.

* Strong understanding of creative for digital-first channels (especially social).

* Excellent attention to detail and ability to manage multiple projects at once.

* Confident communicator who collaborates well across disciplines.

**Copywriter: additional essentials**

* Strong concepting and headline-writing ability.

* Ability to write for different audiences, including B2B/tech and/or consumer (depending on team needs).

**Art Director: additional essentials**

* Strong visual craft and layout skills.

* Proficient in Adobe Creative Suite (InDesign, Photoshop, Illustrator).

London, England, United Kingdom

Techary redefines the way customers procure, implement, and support their organisations' technology, providing an innovative alternative to the traditional Managed Service Provider (MSP) / Value-Added Reseller (VAR) approach.

Our customers range from small start-ups to global enterprises. From designing, deploying and managing infrastructure stacks within low-latency financial trading environments, to relocating the headquarters of a global fintech firm, our operations span multiple markets, industries and geographies.

Techary have helped customers scale their operations globally, gain an advantage in financial markets, enabled mission-critical projects and, most importantly, implemented technology that delivers alpha-accelerating business transformation.

### 

### The Role

We are looking for ambitious and commercially minded Sales Development Representatives (SDRs) to join Techary as part of our January 2027 intake.

Techary is a fast-growing global technology business, working with customers ranging from ambitious scale-ups to some of the world’s largest financial services and enterprise organisations. With teams across the UK, US, Europe and Asia, we are continuing to invest in our sales function as we scale globally.

As an SDR, you will be at the front end of that growth, focused on identifying new opportunities, building relationships and opening doors into large enterprise organisations.

You will learn how to break into complex accounts, identify the people who influence technology decisions and create opportunities with organisations that may never have engaged with Techary before.

Using a combination of cold calling, email, networking and intelligent account research, you will identify target organisations, understand their technology environment and engage senior decision-makers in meaningful commercial conversations.

This is not simply about generating activity or booking meetings. We want our SDRs to understand why they are targeting an organisation, who they should be speaking to and what could create a genuine opportunity for Techary.

You do not need previous enterprise or technology sales experience. We will provide structured training, tools, coaching and hands-on exposure to help you develop. What matters most is your ambition, resilience, curiosity, coachability and confidence to start conversations with new people.

You will join alongside other SDRs as part of our January 2027 intake, developing together while building your own pipeline, target accounts and commercial experience.

For the right person, this is the starting point for a long-term career in technology sales, with a clear progression path from Sales Development Representative to Associate Account Manager and ultimately Account Manager.

### 

### Key Responsibilities:

You will receive structured development designed to give you the foundations for a successful career in enterprise technology sales, including how to:

* Research and understand complex organisations and their technology environments.

We are not looking for someone who already knows everything about technology or enterprise sales. We are looking for people with the attitude, ambition and potential to become successful salespeople.

# Business Operations Transformation Consultant (Contract)

## Help Tecknuovo build simpler, more scalable business operations. Work with teams to clarify ownership, improve processes and strengthen the foundations for sustainable growth.

### About the role

Tecknuovo has grown quickly, and many of the processes, controls and ways of working that support our business have evolved organically alongside that growth. As we look ahead, we want to take a more deliberate approach to how our internal business operations work together, ensuring we have the right foundations to support our next stage of growth.

Our business operations remit extends beyond our core corporate functions of Legal, Governance, Risk and Compliance (GRC), IT, People and Finance. It also includes the operational infrastructure supporting our consultant community, quality assurance, frameworks and accreditations, business systems, suppliers, health and safety, and facilities.

While these areas are functioning, ownership and responsibilities have developed across different teams over time. This has created opportunities to improve how processes connect, clarify accountability, reduce dependencies and ensure operational activities sit in the right places.

We are looking for an experienced Business Operations Transformation Consultant to embed themselves in our business, develop a practical understanding of how our functions and teams operate, and help us build a clearer, simpler and more scalable approach.

This is a hands-on diagnostic and transformation engagement rather than an ongoing operational leadership position. You will work closely with our functional leaders and teams to understand how things work in practice, identify opportunities for improvement and actively support changes that strengthen our operational foundations.

We are not looking to centralise all operational activity, replace existing functional expertise or undertake a wholesale organisational redesign. Our priority is to strengthen the operational infrastructure connecting our teams while preserving the agility, pace and accountability that are important to how Tecknuovo operates.

### Key responsibilities

* Assess our current business operations: Embed yourself across our core functions, working directly with leaders and teams to understand their responsibilities, day-to-day activities, processes and operational challenges. Build a practical, end-to-end understanding of how work gets done, where responsibilities sit and how functions connect.
* Review our operational infrastructure: Evaluate the processes and ownership supporting consultant workforce operations, including screening, onboarding and ongoing compliance; ISO and quality management; operational assurance; frameworks and accreditations; business systems and tooling; supplier contracts and renewals; insurance; health and safety; and office and facilities operations.
* Identify operational gaps and opportunities: Examine where ownership is unclear or overlapping, where processes are fragmented or unnecessarily complex, and where manual activity, duplicated controls, ineffective hand-offs or key-person dependencies create inefficiency or risk. Distinguish between underlying issues and their symptoms to identify which areas genuinely require change.
* Clarify ownership and accountability: Recommend how responsibilities and decision rights should be structured across specialist functional ownership, operational execution, governance, assurance, systems and tooling, technical and cyber security, and business-wide coordination. Ensure improvements strengthen accountability without unnecessarily centralising activity or changing established specialist ownership.
* Improve cross-functional ways of working: Work alongside teams to simplify processes, strengthen communication and improve how information, decisions and responsibilities move between functions. Address gaps between policy, governance and operational execution while maintaining proportionate controls and oversight.
* Shape a scalable future-state operating model: Develop pragmatic recommendations for how internal business operations should evolve as Tecknuovo grows. Consider organisational ownership, functional interfaces, governance and management forums, reporting, operational controls, systems, capability, capacity and organisational resilience.
* Consider evolving technical and operational responsibilities: Assess how internal IT operations interact with wider technical and cyber security capability, identifying where clearer separation of responsibilities or accountability may be appropriate as these areas mature.
* Assess systems and operational dependencies: Review how business systems, suppliers, recurring operational requirements and supporting controls are owned and managed. Identify opportunities for simplification, automation, consolidation and improved resilience.
* Drive and support operational improvements: Take an active role in addressing identified gaps and inefficiencies, working alongside teams to simplify processes, clarify responsibilities, improve hand-offs and implement agreed changes. Balance the wider transformation objectives with practical, hands-on support where it will make the greatest difference.
* Develop a prioritised transformation roadmap: Translate findings into a practical, phased implementation plan that distinguishes between immediate improvements and changes required as the business grows. Identify where accountability needs to evolve, where additional capability may eventually be required and which existing arrangements should be retained.

By the end of the engagement, you will have provided a clear view of our current operational landscape, including critical processes, systems, controls, dependencies and accountability. You will leave us with an agreed understanding of ownership and decision rights, recommendations for a simpler and more joined-up future-state model, and a prioritised roadmap covering processes, systems, governance, assurance, capability and organisational responsibilities, alongside tangible improvements already underway.

### Who you are and how you’ll make an impact

You are an experienced business operations or transformation professional who has previously reviewed, improved and helped shape the internal operations of a growing organisation. Your experience is likely to span operational transformation, business operations and organisational effectiveness, giving you the breadth to look across multiple functions rather than approaching challenges through a single specialist discipline.

You have led end-to-end operational reviews, bringing together an understanding of processes, organisational structures, systems, controls and accountability to identify opportunities for meaningful improvement. You are comfortable working across functions such as Legal/GRC, IT, People and Finance, and understand how their responsibilities and dependencies influence the effectiveness of wider business operations.

You bring strong process and organisational design experience, with the ability to distinguish between issues that require changes to structure or accountability and those that can be addressed through clearer processes, stronger coordination or better use of existing resources.

You understand the importance of operational assurance, quality management, governance and controls, but recognise that these need to be proportionate to the organisation. You can identify operational risks and resilience gaps without defaulting to additional layers of process or oversight.

You are equally comfortable stepping back to assess the bigger operational picture and getting involved in the detail of how things work. You take the time to understand the people, roles and processes behind each function, and are willing to work alongside teams to resolve challenges and put improvements into practice. You bring a practical, delivery-focused approach rather than operating purely in an advisory capacity.

You are confident working directly with senior leadership and established functional experts, asking the right questions, challenging constructively and building a clear understanding of how the business actually operates. You can navigate competing perspectives, make sound judgements about where accountability should sit and translate complex operational findings into straightforward recommendations.

You have experience developing and delivering practical implementation plans that consider organisational maturity, available capability and business priorities. Rather than producing a theoretical target operating model, you focus on changes that can realistically be implemented and sustained.

Experience supporting the growth or transformation of a technology, consulting or professional services organisation would be particularly valuable.

Most importantly, you bring the curiosity and judgement to understand why things work as they do, recognise what is already effective and identify where change will make a genuine difference. Your impact will be measured by the clarity, simplicity and scalability of the approach you leave behind, as well as the practical improvements you help deliver.

### A day in the life

Your day might begin with a discussion with one of our functional leaders to understand how a particular operational process works, who is accountable for it and where it connects with other teams. You could be exploring how consultant onboarding and compliance activities move between functions, or reviewing how operational assurance requirements translate into day-to-day responsibilities.

You might then spend time working directly with colleagues across People, Finance, IT or Legal/GRC, getting underneath how their roles and processes operate in practice. This could involve mapping a cross-functional process, resolving an unclear hand-off, identifying where systems or controls overlap, or helping a team improve an existing way of working.

Later, you may meet with senior leadership to share emerging findings, test assumptions and challenge whether an issue requires a change in accountability, a simpler process or a different approach. You will balance the need for clearer operational ownership with the importance of preserving existing functional expertise and the agility of the business.

As the engagement progresses, you will balance shaping the future-state operating model with actively supporting operational improvements. This could mean working directly with teams to resolve unclear ownership, simplify a process, strengthen a control or establish a more effective way of working.

Throughout the engagement, your focus will be on understanding how Tecknuovo operates today, making practical improvements alongside our teams and leaving the business with both a clear direction for the future and stronger operational foundations already taking shape.

tem exists to fix a broken global energy market that’s long favoured legacy operators, intermediaries, and opaque pricing. Today’s electricity system was not designed for rapid decarbonisation, AI-driven efficiency or fair access for the actual users - businesses and generators.

We're hiring a Senior Software Engineer, Pricing.

* Sharpen the boundaries: extract and consolidate pricing logic so the pricing engine owns its own behaviour end-to-end.
* Close the loop: take your turn handling live pricing questions and incidents, and turn what you learn into structural fixes.

As our **Head of Implementation**, you will build the foundations that let implementation scale: the operating model, the process and the standards we need to grow well beyond where we are today. * **Transform how we implement enterprise customers**: today we deliver well on the strength of the people doing it, and that ceiling is now the thing holding us back. Rebuild the operating model, the standards and the reusable components so we can take on far more without adding a person for every customer, and collapse the time it takes a customer to reach value.

# Category Manager (BFS) - THG Nutrition | Myprotein

Location

UK, Manchester

**About THG**

We are THG, a global ecommerce group on a mission to be the global online leader in beauty and sports nutrition.

Our portfolio of leading retailers and brands such as LOOKFANTASTIC, Myprotein, ESPA, Perricone MD, and Cult Beauty form our two core businesses: THG Beauty and THG Nutrition.

From Manchester to New York, we're powered by a team of over 2500 people who work together, lead by example, and think BIG.

**Life at THG Nutrition**

THG Nutrition is home to some of the world's most trusted and best-loved wellbeing and nutrition brands, including Myprotein, the world's largest online sports nutrition brand, alongside Myvegan, Myvitamins and MP Activewear.

Our brands and people exist to break boundaries - to power and empower those who want more. We move fast, challenge convention, and back ourselves to win. These values shape how we work every day.

**Role: Category Manager | Bars & Snacks**

**Reporting to: Category Director**

**Brand: Myprotein**

**Location: THG HQ, Manchester (WA15 0AF) - Fully Office Based**

**THG Nutrition:**

THG Nutrition is home to some of the best loved and most trusted names in wellbeing and nutrition, including Myprotein, the world's largest online sports nutrition brand, and its family of brands, Myvitamins and MP Activewear. Our brands and people exist to break boundaries; to power and empower those who want more.

**Role Overview**

As the Category Manager, you will be responsible for driving the online commercial success of Bars & Snacks. You will optimise the ecommerce strategy for these categories, ensuring commercial growth and customer engagement across global markets in line with out omni-channel business.

**Key Responsibilities**

***Category Performance & Strategy***

* Develop and implement bars & snacks strategies to maximise online sales, market share, and profitability.
* Analyse internal insights (sales data, pricing trends, site metrics) to make data-driven decisions that optimise category performance.
* Identify category growth opportunities, leveraging global and regional insights to tailor strategies for each market.
* Conduct frequent site audits to ensure optimal customer experience (CX) and category visibility.

***Market & Competitor Analysis***

* Monitor external market trends, including competitor pricing, innovation, and emerging category trends.
* Leverage insights to develop category plans and influence product launches, pricing, and promotional strategies.
* Collaborate with the Brand & Marketing teams to align product positioning with industry trends and customer demand.
* Collaborate with the internal Retail, Wholesale, Tiktok & Amazon teams to understand insights & omnichannel sales to drive online decisions.

***Pricing & Promotion Optimisation***

* Own the pricing strategy for assigned categories, ensuring profitability while remaining competitive in each market.
* Work closely with country managers to optimise pricing across Myprotein sites, balancing growth and margin targets.
* Work closely with the internal Retail, Wholesale, Tiktok & Amazon teams to balance the calendar plans to drive growth across channels
* Develop and implement promotional plans, working with digital marketing teams to drive customer acquisition and retention.

***Cross-Functional Collaboration***

* Partner with supply chain & production teams to ensure optimal stock availability across all international warehouses.
* Collaborate with procurement, finance & logistics to improve cost efficiencies and bottom-line profitability.
* Support senior stakeholders in optimising locale & sales channels mix, reducing cost prices, and managing discount strategies.
* Work closely with customer service teams to address category-specific customer concerns, ensuring a customer-centric approach to category management.

***Performance Tracking & Reporting***

* Establish and maintain reporting processes to track category performance at a territory level.
* Present insights and strategic recommendations to senior leadership and key stakeholders.
* Continuously monitor key performance indicators (KPIs) and adjust strategies accordingly to drive category success.

**What We're Looking For**

* Proven experience in Ecommerce, Category Management, or Digital Trading, ideally within retail, FMCG, or nutrition/bars & snacks sectors.
* Strong analytical skills with the ability to interpret data and translate insights into actionable strategies.
* Commercial mindset with experience in pricing, promotion, and margin optimisation.
* Ability to build strong cross-functional relationships and influence stakeholders across marketing, finance, supply chain, and country teams.
* Detail-oriented with a strong understanding of customer experience (CX) and ecommerce best practices.
* Proficiency in analytics tools (e.g., BI platforms i.e. Tableau) and ecommerce platforms.
* Strong organisational and communication skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities.
* Proficiency in excel, SQL & Ai Tools would be desirable as well, but not essential





**Career Development**

* Access bespoke development programmes that have been designed and developed by our in-house L&D team.

* Continued development through our upskilling programme that is delivered in partnership with an industry-leading training provider.

**Enhanced Leave**

* 25 days annual leave plus bank holidays.



* Enhanced maternity and paternity pay, depending on length of service.

* Up to 10 days compassionate leave.

* Buy back up to 3 days each year.

* Unlock 2 days volunteer leave after 12-months.

**Wellbeing Support**

* Access face-to-face and virtual appointments with our in-house GP.
* Access our 247 Employee Assistance Programme (EAP) which is provided by Bupa.

* State-of-the-art on-site gym.

* Access to our on-site physio.

* Save up to 12% on the cost of personal tech through our salary sacrifice scheme.

* Subsidised bus pass from Manchester City Centre to our ICON office.

* Up to 50% staff discount on THG brands.
* On-site staff shop.

* Anniversary gifts when you hit 5 and 10 years of service.

From delivering product launches and key trading campaigns to improving conversion and retention, you will play a central role in growing revenue and building customer loyalty across Myprotein’s nutrition, supplements and activewear ranges.

## Description

Tokamak Energy is a global leader in fusion energy and high temperature superconducting (HTS) technologies. We work with governments and industry to develop and bring fusion and HTS solutions to market through innovation and strategic partnerships. A major part of this is our end to end capability in HTS systems, from design to manufacturing.

We are the Magnet Systems Partner for the UK Government's STEP Fusion programme, under a £70 million contract running to 2029, working with UK Fusion Energy to deliver HTS magnet systems for the STEP prototype power plant, while also contributing to tokamak systems and plasma integration.

Founded in 2009 as a spin-out from the UK Atomic Energy Authority, Tokamak Energy is headquartered in Oxfordshire, with subsidiaries in the United States and Japan. Today, we employ over 300 people and have secured more than £280 million in investment.

***We operate through three divisions:***

**Fusion -** Fusion energy technologies, expertise and testbeds for government and private fusion programmes, including ST40, the world’s highest field spherical tokamak.

**TE Magnetics -** HTS systems for commercial applications including fusion energy, power distribution, life sciences, and propulsion.

**Ridgway Machines -** Manufacturing equipment for the superconducting, electrical and wider energy sectors, enabling the rapid industrialisation of HTS products.

### **The Opportunity**

We are looking for an Operations & Process Engineer to play a pivotal role in the industrialisation of an innovative manufacturing environment. This is a highly visible position that sits at the intersection of engineering, operations, quality, EHS, projects and supply chain.

You will help transform development activities into robust, repeatable manufacturing processes. You will take ownership of operational challenges, drive continuous improvement, and help establish the systems, workflows and production capability required to support growth and delivery objectives.

This role will appeal to someone who enjoys creating structure, influencing across multiple teams, and driving change in a fast-moving environment where priorities can evolve quickly.

Tokamak Energy is looking for a Senior Manufacturing & Industrialisation Engineer to help build and scale the manufacturing capability within TE Magnetics.

This is a senior, hands-on engineering role for an experienced manufacturing or process engineer who has designed production systems, introduced new processes and helped transition technically complex products from R&D or prototype manufacture into repeatable production.

You will take ownership of manufacturing processes and value streams, working across Engineering, Operations, Quality, EHS and Supply Chain to create safe, efficient and scalable production capability.

The environment is evolving, so you will need to be comfortable creating processes and systems where established solutions may not yet exist.

### **Key responsibilities**

* Design, develop and implement manufacturing processes, production lines and value streams.
* Lead the industrialisation of products moving from R&D and prototype manufacture into repeatable production.
* Develop factory layouts, production flows, workstations, tooling and manufacturing systems.
* Identify equipment and technology requirements, develop business cases and support CAPEX delivery.
* Establish process controls, standard work, manufacturing documentation and performance measures.
* Improve safety, quality, cost, delivery, capacity and productivity across manufacturing operations.
* Lead structured problem-solving and root cause investigations using tools such as 8D, A3, DMAIC, 5 Whys and Fishbone analysis.
* Apply Lean Manufacturing and Six Sigma principles to eliminate waste, improve flow and remove production bottlenecks.
* Support NPI, process validation, production readiness and manufacturing ramp-up activities.
* Use manufacturing data and KPIs to identify priorities and measure improvements.
* Work with ERP and MRP systems to improve production planning, control and traceability.
* Influence and coordinate cross-functional stakeholders without relying on direct reporting authority.
* Coach engineers, technicians and production teams in manufacturing best practice.

### **Working Pattern**

This is a full-time permanent position based in Abingdon. Given the operational nature of the role, a predominantly on-site presence is expected.

## Requirements

**Essential Experience**

* Substantial career experience in manufacturing engineering, process engineering or industrialisation, with demonstrable ownership of production-line development, value-stream design and manufacturing scale-up
* Proven experience designing, creating or substantially improving production lines and manufacturing value streams.
* Experience taking technically complex products from R&D, development or prototype manufacture into repeatable production.
* Demonstrable delivery of manufacturing industrialisation, factory transformation or production scale-up programmes.
* Strong knowledge of Lean Manufacturing, Six Sigma and structured problem-solving methodologies.
* Experience of process development, process validation, production documentation and manufacturing controls.
* Experience leading cross-functional improvement projects involving Engineering, Operations, Quality, EHS and Supply Chain.
* Strong understanding of production capacity, flow, cycle time, bottleneck analysis, OEE and manufacturing KPIs.
* Experience developing CAPEX requirements and introducing new production equipment.

The CMM Programmer develops, verifies, and maintains automated inspection programs for Coordinate Measuring Machines (CMM) to ensure manufactured parts meet exact engineering drawing requirements, Geometric Dimensioning and Tolerancing (GD&T) callouts, and customer specifications. Operating within regulated manufacturing environments, this role requires high configuration control discipline to manage inspection routines, CAD models, and measurement program revisions. The ideal candidate blends technical metrology expertise with strong communication and organizational skills to interface across Engineering, Machining, and Quality teams.

**Tasks and Responsibilities:**

**CMM Programming & Metrology:**

* Write, debug, optimize, and maintain offline and online CMM inspection routines using CMM Manager (or similar) software from 3D CAD models and engineering drawings.
* Apply advanced Geometric Dimensioning and Tolerancing (GD&T) principles per ASME Y14.5 to establish accurate datum frameworks and measurement alignment features.
* Design or specify custom holding fixtures, stylus configurations, and probing setups to ensure repeatable inspection routines.

**QC Inspection & First Article Verification:**

* Perform complex First Article Inspections (FAI) per AS9102 standards, setup inspections, and final receiving/in-process dimensional verifications.
* Utilize secondary precision measuring hand tools (micrometers, height gauges, optical comparators, pin gauges) to supplement CMM routines as needed.
* Generate clear, accurate inspection records, dimensional reports, and non-conformance (NC) reports in the QMS system.

**Configuration Control & Revision Management:**

* Maintain strict configuration control over CMM programs, inspection plans, and CAD files - ensuring programs strictly mirror approved engineering drawing revisions.
* Manage file folder structures, archive obsolete inspection programs, and log revision changes under controlled Quality Management System (QMS) protocols.
* Validate program changes triggered by Engineering Change Notices (ECNs) or customer drawing revisions before releasing routines to shop floor operators.

**Cross-Functional Communication & Technical Collaboration:**

* Communicate non-conformances, out-of-tolerance conditions, and measurement trends promptly to Quality Engineers, Processor / Machinists, and Production Leads.
* Collaborate with Manufacturing/Quality/Tooling Engineers to troubleshoot machining defects, refine fixture designs, and reduce measurement cycle times.
* Train and support quality inspectors and floor operators on standard loading procedures and basic program execution.

**Equipment Calibration & Maintenance:**

* Oversee routine CMM maintenance, qualify probe tips, and perform system checkouts to maintain calibration integrity.
* Assist in Gage R&R studies, measurement uncertainty analyses, and internal metrology audits.

* High School Diploma or equivalent required.
* Associate Degree or certification in CMM programming, Metrology, or Quality Technology preferred.
* 5+ years of hands-on Quality Control inspection experience in a precision manufacturing environment.
* Minimum 3+ years of direct experience creating and modifying CMM programs using 3D CAD data.

## Company Description

At Turner & Townsend we're passionate about making the difference. That means delivering better outcomes for our clients, helping our people realise their potential, and doing our part to create a prosperous society.

Every day we help our major global clients deliver ambitious and highly technical projects in over 130 countries worldwide.

Our team is dynamic, innovative, and client-focused, supported by an inclusive and collaborative culture. Our clients value our proactive approach, depth of expertise, integrity, and the quality we deliver. As a result, our people enjoy working on some of the most exciting programmes in the world.

## Job Description

Turner & Townsend's Digital Advisory business is growing and building capability to meet our 2030 Strategy. We are seeking an experienced Change & Transformation Consultant with a track record of delivering business transformation, change management and process improvement initiatives within asset-intensive industries, the built environment, energy and natural resources, or defence. Knowledge of data governance, data operating models, data architecture and data platforms is desirable.

* Service delivery excellence: Delivering digital transformation, change management, adoption programmes, process improvement and business readiness engagements across a range of client sectors.

* Business Generation capability: Contributing to bid writing, proposal development, client presentations and lead generation activities.

* People & Operations: Collaborating across multidisciplinary teams, sharing knowledge, mentoring colleagues and supporting a positive and inclusive team culture.

* Service development: Contributing to the development of change and transformation propositions, methodologies, playbooks, tools and best-practice resources.

The team offers a wide range of commissions covering the UK. Candidates would be expected to travel up to 2-3 days per week supporting the delivery of the commissions. As a global business we deliver projects anywhere in the world for our global client base so future flexibility would be advantageous.

Key Requirements

1. The successful candidate will support the delivery of digital transformation and change programmes across a range of sectors. This will include helping organisations adopt new technologies, improve ways of working and successfully embed change. They will also contribute to the development of our Change & Transformation service offering through knowledge sharing, market insight and business development activities.

1. Candidates must be able to demonstrate strong communication and stakeholder engagement skills, with the ability to build effective working relationships across client organisations. This includes engaging with stakeholders at all levels, understanding user needs and supporting the successful adoption of new processes, systems and ways of working.

1. Candidates will be expected to contribute to workshops, interviews and stakeholder engagement sessions to understand business challenges, gather requirements and identify opportunities for improvement. Experience of business analysis, process mapping or continuous improvement approaches would be advantageous.

1. Experience supporting digital transformation and business change projects delivered through Agile and/or Waterfall approaches is desirable. Candidates should be able to contribute to activities such as stakeholder engagement, change impact assessments, communication planning, training, business readiness and implementation support.

1. Candidates should be able to understand business, operational and user requirements and help develop practical solutions that support organisational objectives. This includes supporting the design of future ways of working, developing implementation plans and helping teams successfully transition to new processes and technologies.

1. Experience supporting technology adoption and organisational change initiatives is desirable. Candidates should be comfortable working with both technical and non-technical stakeholders, translating business needs into clear requirements and supporting the implementation and adoption of new digital tools and solutions.

1. Familiarity with change management principles, organisational change methodologies or digital adoption approaches is desirable. Experience developing stakeholder engagement plans, communications, training materials, user guidance and adoption activities would be advantageous.

* Support the delivery of digital and data transformation programmes across strategic sectors, such as Energy and Natural Resources, Defence, Infrastructure and Government.

* Provide advice to clients on digital transformation, change management, digital strategy, technology adoption and related transformation priorities.

* Contribute to business growth through lead generation, bid writing and proposal development.

* Share knowledge and provide support to colleagues, contributing to a culture of excellence and innovation.

* Contribute to the development and enhancement of Turner & Townsend’s digital and data advisory service offerings through proposition development and knowledge management.

* Support the delivery of change and transformation engagements, helping clients improve processes, ways of working and business outcomes.

* Gather and analyse business requirements, facilitate workshops and support process improvement, digital transformation and change implementation activities.

* Support digital adoption programmes by helping stakeholders understand, embrace and embed new technologies, systems and ways of working.

* Produce high-quality deliverables and build effective stakeholder relationships.

Business Generation

* Support business development activities through opportunity identification, bid writing and proposal development.

* Contribute to client presentations and help build positive client relationships that support future opportunities.

* Collaborate effectively with colleagues across the Digital Advisory practice and wider business, sharing knowledge and supporting others where appropriate.

* Promote a collaborative and inclusive team culture.

Service Development

* Support the development of change and transformation methodologies, playbooks, templates and reusable assets.

* Research industry trends and share insights to help continuously improve our service offering.

### Job Introduction

At Turning Point, we are recognised leaders in supporting people to recover from addiction and regain control of their lives. Our work spans substance use, learning disabilities and mental health, and we focus on providing timely, person‐centred support. By ensuring people can access the help they need through a single point of contact, we have grown into one of the largest providers of substance use services across England and Wales. We are now seeking a skilled and compassionate HCPC‐registered Clinical, Counselling or Forensic Psychologist to support the effective delivery of psycho‐social interventions across our Southwest MHTR services, covering Swindon, Somerset and North Somerset.

Our Primary Mental Health Treatment Requirement (MHTR) service offers individuals within the Criminal Justice System an opportunity to engage in psycho‐social interventions as an alternative to custodial sentences. It forms part of a national network of psychology‐led MHTR services.

Turning Point’s MHTR approach places strong emphasis on tailoring support to each individual, drawing on evidence‐based interventions to develop personalised treatment plans. To ensure the consistent delivery of high‐quality, evidence-based interventions, we prioritise regular clinical supervision and the use of standardised outcome measures across the team.

As a Practitioner Psychologist we offer a starting salary of £49,233 rising each year in line with our pay progression salary bands to £55,307 per year. (Dependent on experience you may be offered a starting salary above the initial starting salary).

This is a remote, full time, fixed term position for 12 months.

*Please note that applicants requiring a placement as part of a professional training course will not be considered at this stage*

### Role Responsibility

You will provide clinical supervision, guidance and training to a team of Senior Assistant and Assistant Psychologists who deliver psycho‐social interventions to individuals subject to a Mental Health Treatment Requirement (MHTR). You will draw on your expertise to further develop the innovative approaches used within Turning Point’s MHTR services, ensuring they align with nationally agreed standards and evidence‐based practice. Alongside operational colleagues, you will contribute to the effective governance of the Southwest MHTR services and offer thoughtful, evidence‐informed advice to colleagues, local agencies and partner organisations. You will receive supervision from a Forensic Psychologist who serves as the Southwest MHTR Clinical Lead, who is in turn supported by the National MHTR Lead, a Consultant Clinical Psychologist.

Supporting, developing and coordinating the team will be a core part of your role. You will help Senior Assistant and Assistant Psychologists, as well as Peer Support Workers, to strengthen their psychological formulation skills and embed a trauma‐informed approach within their practice. At times, you may also hold a small caseload, providing specialist psychological assessments and therapeutic interventions.

Beyond day‐to‐day delivery, you will play a key role in shaping the strategic direction and ongoing development of the service. You will also have the opportunity to work closely with our large national team of Clinical, Counselling and Forensic Psychologists to further develop psychological and psycho‐social approaches across services, while continuing to grow your own expertise within a therapeutic specialism aligned with service needs.

Applicants must hold current HCPC registration as a Clinical, Counselling or Forensic Psychologist and a doctoral qualification in their professional specialism.

**Join us as we launch a brand-new residential rehabilitation and Discharge to Assess service supporting people with complex mental health needs to achieve greater independence and successful move-on outcomes.**

At Turning Point, we believe recovery is possible for everyone. We are seeking an experienced and motivated **Night Team Leader** to help shape and develop The Stewarts, an innovative residential service providing both Intensive Enablement and Discharge to Assess (D2A) pathways.

As a Night Team Leader, you will play a critical role in leading and supporting the overnight team, ensuring people receive safe, high-quality, person-centred and recovery-focused support throughout the night. You will be responsible for maintaining a safe, therapeutic and responsive environment while overseeing the delivery of support, managing risk and ensuring positive outcomes for the people we support.

NERC’s science spans the entire earth system from the atmosphere to the biosphere, hydrosphere, sub-surface, oceanic and the polar regions. Our sustained funding of six NERC research centres provides the ‘national capability’ foundations for the UK environmental science endeavour making long-term and large-scale observing and modelling possible through investment in major research infrastructures (including research stations in polar regions, a fleet of Royal Research Ships and aircraft, and satellite technologies and monitoring stations), which provide the UK with world class expertise and data in critical science areas. 

We ensure our data assets from our investments are widely accessible in the form of the NERC Environmental Data Service (EDS) which holds over 25 terabytes of data across more than 16,000 distinct datasets. We have ambition to considerably enhance this and develop new applications and markets including through Environmental Data Research UK. In this way we can do much more to secure the UK’s global leadership on climate resilience by leveraging these assets to support sustainable economic growth through a harmonised data, digital and commercial approach. Consequently, this role is designed to capitalise on the goals of the UKRI strategy to ensure the entire organisation of over 9,000 people is more agile and responsive, and work more easily across Councils, Innovate UK and Research England, to make best use of our talented people in supporting the UKRI mission and delivering UKRI strategy. For NERC, growing teams that draw together the digital and data function, and the commercialisation function across the whole of the NERC investment portfolio within UKRI is key.

In recent years NERC has consolidated data provision across its Centres in the form of the NERC Environmental Data Service (EDS) - the UK’s central network for environmental data management. It ensures that UK environmental science data is curated, preserved, and made open for long-term reuse in line with FAIR (Findable, Accessible, Interoperable, and Reusable) principles.

**ABOUT THE ROLE**

You will be NERC’s executive leader for environmental data, informing our digital transformation and digital research infrastructure needs, artificial intelligence and the responsible creation of value from these assets as well as other NERC investments.

As a newly created role, the Executive Director of Environmental Data, Innovation and Growth offers a rare opportunity to shape a bold, future-focused agenda for environmental science data, advancing knowledge while accelerating the application of research and innovation to deliver economic and societal benefit. You will have the opportunity to shape the data, inform the digital platforms and initiate our commercialisation portfolio as part of NERC’s new operating model, establishing the organisational capabilities, accountabilities and ways of working needed to deliver the role’s responsibilities.

This is a pivotal leadership role at the heart of NERC and UKRI. You will set and deliver NERC’s strategy and model development for data and digital, aligned with NERC’s scientific priorities and UKRI’s priority programmes. You will harness the opportunities set out in the UKRI strategy for a resilient Digital Research Infrastructure and AI Research and Innovation Strategic Framework. You will be responsible for shaping business development opportunities across the NERC investment portfolio, drawing on the UKRI Chief Development Officer and Innovate UK teams to define commercialisation opportunities from NERC investments.

**OBJECTIVES**

You will establish and embed a new enterprise-wide approach to environmental data, innovation and growth through e.g. commercialisation potential across NERC, maximising the potential of our data assets across all NERC investments. This will require clear accountabilities, effective governance and a joined-up approach to capabilities, investment and ways of working, while protecting the specialist and mission-critical expertise on which environmental science depends.

A core element of the role will be building and leveraging partnerships across UKRI, government, research organisations, industry, philanthropy and international networks. You will use the strength of NERC’s science, data and infrastructure to attract external investment, supporting our research funding investments to enable innovation and create greater public value.

**WAYS OF WORKING**

As a member of the NERC Executive Team, you will work collectively with NERC’s Directors to ensure coherence and optimisation across the full NERC portfolio and to lead NERC through UKRI’s wider transformation.

You will work particularly closely with the Executive Director of Science to ensure that NERC’s research investments generate high-quality, accessible and reusable data, models and analytical tools and that researchers have the skills, platforms and computational capabilities needed for the future.

You will work with NERC’s Chief Operating Officer, who is responsible for the operational lifecycle of NERC’s infrastructure and assets, to ensure that strategic requirements for data and digital capability are translated into sustainable, resilient and effectively managed services and infrastructure, and, commercialisation potential of NERC’s infrastructure and facilities is realised.

You will also work closely with UKRI’s digital, data and technology leadership under the Chief Information Officer and commercialisation offer under the Chief Development Officer to connect NERC’s specialist capabilities with UKRI-wide platforms, services and standards, particularly enabling good data stewardship. You will ensure that NERC’s digital infrastructure is anchored effectively within UKRI’s wider ambitions so that environmental data can be stored, curated and shared efficiently across organisational and disciplinary boundaries.

**MAIN OUTPUTS AND ACTIVITIES**

Reporting directly to the NERC Executive Chair, you will have responsibility for:

**Enterprise strategy and executive leadership**

* Ensuring NERC’s data, digital platform requirements and potential commercial capabilities inform the design and delivery of its research investments, including programme governance, peer review, partnership development, impact generation and evaluation of outcomes.
* Setting and delivering NERC's strategy for data, innovation and transformation, aligned with NERC, UKRI and national research priorities, including the NROs.
* Acting as NERC's executive lead for data innovation and digital needs, ensuring investment and delivery are driven by scientific impact, organisational value and affordability.
* Contributing to the overall leadership, performance, culture and strategic direction of NERC.

**Environmental data leadership and stewardship**

* Working with the Executive Director of Science, ensuring NERC’s investments in long-term observations, environmental models and data services remain scientifically aligned, sustainable and fit for purpose.
* Providing strategic leadership for the stewardship, governance and utilisation of NERC-funded environmental data.
* Establishing an enterprise-wide data and digital function across NERC, BAS and BGS, ensuring this function delivers across the whole of NERC’s investment portfolio.
* Championing responsible, secure and ethical data use.

**Digital research infrastructure and transformation**

* Leading the strategic development of NERC's requirements of UKRI digital research infrastructure and associated transformation programmes.
* Ensuring specialist environmental science capabilities are aligned with wider UKRI digital, data and technology strategies.
* Driving a coherent and sustainable approach to digital platforms, services and computational capabilities.
* Overseeing the delivery, governance and benefits realisation of major data investments.

**Environmental Data for Research UK**

* Leading the future development of Environmental Data for Research UK (EDRUK) within NERC and across UKRI, taking care to build from the effective parts of the existing Environmental Data Service (EDS) so we can move at pace to fully exploit potential new markets and applications.
* Building partnerships and delivery models across UKRI, government and the wider research community.
* Ensuring researchers can effectively discover, access and use environmental data and analytical tools.

**Artificial intelligence for the environment**

* Working with colleagues across UKRI, leading NERC's approach for the responsible use of artificial intelligence.
* Developing investment priorities and partnerships that maximise the value of AI across environmental research and operations.
* Ensuring appropriate governance, ethics, transparency and security arrangements are in place.

**Supporting business development and external investment**

* Leading NERC's approach to business opportunities and external investment related to its science, data and research infrastructure, working closely with UKRI structures to inform delivery.
* Developing external investment, partnerships and innovation opportunities across the NERC investment portfolio.
* Developing investable propositions that can we shaped into commercial pathways with research centres, partners and through UKRI service provision.

**People, capability and culture**

* Leading and developing a high-performing, inclusive and multidisciplinary team.
* Building the environmental data, innovation and transformation capabilities required for the future.
* Providing visible leadership across NERC's wider data and digital community.
* Championing equality, diversity, inclusion and effective organisational change.

**Governance, finance and assurance**

* Holding accountability for assigned budgets, programmes, services and associated benefits.
* Ensuring robust governance, risk management, financial control and value for money across the portfolio.
* Providing high-quality advice and assurance to NERC and UKRI governance bodies.
* Ensuring compliance with relevant policies, delegated authorities and regulatory requirements.

**ASSESSMENT CRITERIA**

We are seeking a dynamic, creative and respected leader who is inspired by the opportunity to shape and fund the future of environmental data science. You will command professional esteem, ideally across public and private sectors, and engage proactively with NERC and UKRI’s diverse science, data and digital communities. You will draw on their expertise to shape future investment priorities and build partnership and leverage opportunities through trusted relationships with senior academic, public-sector, industry and international leaders.

Success will require strategic oversight and the ability to adapt at pace, keeping ahead of emerging scientific priorities and rapidly advancing technological and computational capabilities while supporting teams to deliver at scale.

* Established credibility in environmental science, data-intensive research or a related field, together with a strong understanding of the UK research and innovation landscape and the role of data and digital capability in enabling research outcomes. (S)
* Strong understanding of data ecosystems, digital platforms, computational research infrastructure, interoperability and the opportunities and risks presented by artificial intelligence. (I)
* Proven ability to lead major programmes, organisational change and cross-boundary partnerships, navigate uncertainty and maintain delivery in complex and fast-moving environments. (S&I)
* Strong governance, assurance and risk-management capability across data, cyber security, artificial intelligence, intellectual property, investment and operational resilience. (I)
* Strong financial and commercial acumen, including experience of managing significant budgets and investments, building strategic partnerships and translating scientific or technological capability into commercial outcomes of societal and/or UK PLC benefits. (S&I)
* Inclusive and credible senior leadership, with excellent communication and influencing skills and a record of building multidisciplinary capability and high-performing teams across organisational boundaries. (S&I)
