Viridien (www.viridiengroup.com) is an advanced technology, digital and Earth data company that pushes the boundaries of science for a more prosperous and sustainable future. With our ingenuity, drive and deep curiosity we discover new insights, innovations, and solutions that efficiently and responsibly resolve complex natural resource, digital, energy transition and infrastructure challenges.

**Do you want to use physics and mathematics to solve real world problems?** Are you looking for a career in industry where you can continue to develop your scientific skills and knowledge?

  

Viridien operates in a rapidly changing global technology market providing high-end scientific solutions primarily to the **natural resources and energy sectors**. A focus on innovation, quality, and client service are key to our success—supported by a culture of learning, collaboration, and ambition.

  

You will use the latest signal processing, modelling and imaging technology and some of the most advanced high-performance computing facilities in the world to build high-resolution 3D seismic images & models of subsurface geology and rock properties for our clients.

  

Our clients trust us because of our exceptional problem solving, best-in-class technology and collaborative mindset. You will join people who are passionate about science, are curious and question the status quo, and always seek to improve our technology.

  

**What skills will you develop as a geophysicist?**

Early in your career you can expect to develop expertise in:

* Signal processing, modelling and imaging
* Technical innovation, creative problem solving and critical thinking
* Building and maintaining long-term client relationships through service excellence
* Management of complex technical projects
* Effective communication and collaboration with team members and clients
* Cultural awareness through training & interaction with global clients and teams

  

Later in your career, you will have opportunities to develop leadership and management skills, publish papers and present at industry conferences

Most people who start with Viridien come from outside the earth sciences; we will provide all necessary training in geology and geophysics.

  

**What we look for**

This role is aimed at recent graduates and final-year students with a Bachelors, integrated or postgraduate Masters or PhD in Physics, Geophysics, or Mathematics, or in Earth Sciences, Natural Sciences or Engineering with significant physics content.

  

We’ll consider what you’ve learned from your course and projects, any part-time work or internships, and extracurricular activities or volunteering. If you are selected during the application process, you’ll have the opportunity to share:

* How you solve problems and identify the details that matter
* Your interest in learning and curiosity about how things work
* Your ability to communicate technical concepts
* Examples of leadership, teamwork or customer service.

  

**Additional Information**

* **Application deadline:** 31st May 2027. Note we conduct rolling interviews.
* **Start date:** September 6th 2027 although we can be flexible around start date if a later start date is desired or necessary.
* **Location:** We are located in **Crawley**, just south of London; well connected to the capital, the South Coast, and Gatwick Airport for international travel.
* We welcome applications from outside the UK and international students studying in the UK; subject to eligibility we can provide visa sponsorship and relocation support
* Explore our Careers page, Gradcracker Hub, and Viridien Stories to learn more about our people, projects, and application tips.

  

**Why work with us?**

At Viridien, your contribution has a real impact on the success of our projects. You’ll work with colleagues from diverse international backgrounds who support one another, share knowledge openly, and welcome new ideas.

  

From day one, you’ll be paired with a buddy and supported by a dedicated training team. You’ll be mentored by colleagues and managers, with opportunities to develop your technical and professional skills, showcase your work to senior managers, and present at monthly tech talks.

  

* Starting salary from £38,000 and bonus scheme
* Initial 22 days annual leave with future increases, complemented by a flexible buying and selling holiday program & bank holiday swap
* Housing allowance of £1200/month for the first six months subject to tax and national insurance and distance relocating.
* Hybrid model and flexible working with up to 2 days at home
* Company pension with generous employer contribution
* Wellbeing Unmind app – puts you in control of your mental health
* Flexible benefits platform with discount schemes including gym membership
* Cycle purchase scheme
* Tailored private medical and dental care

**Our Hiring Process**

At Viridien, we are committed to delivering a respectful, inclusive, and transparent recruitment experience.

Due to the high volume of applications we receive, we may not be able to provide individual feedback to every applicant. Only candidates whose qualifications closely match the role criteria will be contacted for an interview. We do, however, aim to share personalized feedback with those who progress to the first round of interviews and beyond.

We are also dedicated to ensuring that our hiring process accessible to all. If you require any reasonable adjustments to fully participate in the application or interview stages, please don’t hesitate to contact your recruiter directly.

We see things differently. Diversity fuels our innovation, we value the unique ways in which we differ, and we are committed to equal employment opportunities for all professionals.

**Job summary**

The Purchase Ledger Analyst is responsible for the end‐to‐end purchase‐to‐pay process, ensuring robust control over purchase orders and goods receipts. The role acts as a key point of contact for internal stakeholders and suppliers, supporting accurate and timely invoice resolution and contributing to a clean and well‐controlled month‐end close.

In addition, the role supports supplier governance through pre‐qualification, due diligence, and onboarding, ensuring supplier master data is accurate, compliant, and well maintained. **Duties and Responsibilities**

· Monitor and follow up on outstanding goods receipts to ensure timely and accurate posting.

· Support invoice processing through three way matching (PO, GR, invoice) and resolution of discrepancies.

· Act as a first point of contact for PO, GR, and invoice queries from internal stakeholders and suppliers.

· Support month end close by ensuring accurate cut off, resolution of GR/IR balances, and timely follow up of outstanding items.

**Supplier Pre Qualification & Due Diligence**

· Support supplier pre qualification processes in line with internal governance and compliance requirements.

· Perform supplier due diligence checks, ensuring all required documentation is obtained, reviewed, and appropriately recorded.

· Escalate supplier risks, exceptions, or incomplete documentation in accordance with internal controls.

**Supplier Registration & Onboarding**

· Manage supplier registration and onboarding requests, ensuring supplier master data is complete, accurate, and compliant.

· Maintain the integrity of supplier master data, including ongoing updates and periodic reviews.

· Provide guidance to internal stakeholders and suppliers on onboarding requirements and timelines.

**Operational Procurement Support**

· Provide day to day operational procurement support across the business, including guidance on PO creation and process adherence.

· Support the implementation and ongoing adherence to procurement policies and standard operating procedures.

· Assist with continuous improvement initiatives across the procure to pay process, including standardisation and documentation.

You will have a passion and enthusiasm for product and a keen interest in our product categories. It’s essential to have a keen eye for detail and accuracy and you need to have amazing time management, communication, and organizational skills.

As a Senior Assistant Merchandiser at White Stuff, you will play a key role in planning and trading your department, using commercial analysis to identify opportunities and risks and recommend actions that maximise full-price sales, margin and stock productivity.

* Use historical performance, customer insight and commercial analysis to shape seasonal range plans, including lessons learnt, options, buy quantities, price architecture and line productivity.

* Actively manage intake, launch positions, availability and stock cover, working cross-functionally to identify risks and protect sales.
* Proactively manage supplier relationships and the critical path, challenging delays and driving solutions to protect intake, availability and trade performance.
* Review size performance and recommend buying ratios and balance backs.
* Present trading performance, risks, opportunities and recommendations to Buying, Merchandising and cross-functional stakeholders.
* Coach and develop the department MAA, setting priorities, reviewing output and building their technical and commercial capability.
* Support Merchandising training for MAAs and new Assistant Merchandisers.

* Strong WSSI, forecasting and stock-management experience.
* Understanding of OTB and seasonal investment planning.
* Strong numerical and analytical capability.
* Advanced Excel skills and confidence working with large datasets.
* Ability to translate analysis into clear commercial recommendations.
* Strong understanding of retail KPIs including sales, margin, stock, cover, markdown and availability.
* Confident written and verbal communication.
* Ability to present a concise commercial trading story.
* Strong customer and product awareness.
* Confidence working cross-functionally with Buying and wider channel teams.
* Ability to prioritise and make decisions in a fast-moving trading environment.
* Experience coaching or developing an MAA/Allocator is desirable.

As an MMA Analyst, you will play a crucial role in analysing Mixed Martial Arts (MMA) events, fighters, and fight dynamics to provide actionable insights to Traders and our Quantitative Specialists. * Analyse upcoming MMA fights and assess key factors that could influence outcomes.
* Write detailed reports on fight cards, covering fighters, matchups, and key variables.
* Conduct research 2-3 weeks ahead of a fight card to gather relevant insights.
* Collaborate closely with Traders and Quantitative Specialists to deliver timely and accurate insights.
* Monitor fighter statistics, historical performance, and fight conditions.
* Stay up-to-date with the latest news and developments in the MMA world.
* Perform a mixture of research and trading activities.
* Present findings clearly and effectively to team members and stakeholders.

* Opportunities for career growth in a dynamic and exciting industry.

# Enablement Lead

## Location

Edinburgh

## Employment Type

Full time

## Location Type

On-site

## Department

Transformation

OverviewApplication

**About Wordsmith**  
Wordsmith is building the legal operating system for in-house teams, and we're growing fast.

In-house legal is becoming one of the most important functions in the AI era. Every business is moving faster, but legal work is still scattered across inboxes, chats, documents and disconnected systems. Wordsmith brings that work into one place: requests come in from across the business, AI agents handle the routine, lawyers stay in control where judgement matters, and every step is captured as work happens.

We're built for in-house legal, not law firms. More than 500 companies use Wordsmith, including Financial Times, Safelite, Trip.com, Canva, Starling and Sage. We're backed by over $100M from Index Ventures, General Catalyst, Highland Europe and others.  
  
**The role**

We're hiring an Enablement Lead to own how customers learn Wordsmith, and how they become confident, self-sufficient users of it.

You'll own onboarding, training and enablement end to end: Legal AI fundamentals, product and feature overviews, self-paced certifications, and re-enablement for customers who've stalled. You'll teach both ends of the customer organisation: the lawyers and business users in Wordsmith every day, and the champions and admins who support their colleagues.

This is an enablement role, not a delivery or commercial one. You won't own implementation, technical support, renewals, account growth or a sales quota. Your focus is capability: do customers know how to use Wordsmith well, and can they keep learning without us?

## What you'll do

* **Own customer onboarding.** Design and run the journey that takes a newly implemented customer to a confident, capable team, and keep improving it.
* **Teach Legal AI fundamentals.** Build the curriculum that helps legal teams understand what AI agents do well, where judgement stays with them, and how to work alongside the technology.
* **Run live training.** Lead onboarding sessions, product walkthroughs and feature deep dives for lawyers, business users and admins of every technical confidence level.
* **Build the self-paced academy.** Create online certifications and learning paths so customers can train new joiners and refresh skills on their own.
* **Maintain the enablement library.** Keep guides and product overviews accurate as Wordsmith ships, and retire what's out of date.
* **Re-enable struggling customers.** Diagnose why adoption has stalled and run focused programmes that get teams back to self-sufficiency.
* **Train the champions.** Equip customer champions and admins to teach their own colleagues, so capability compounds inside each account.
* **Shape in-app help.** Work with Product to build guidance, walkthroughs and prompts into Wordsmith itself.
* **Measure whether learning worked.** Define what a trained, self-sufficient customer looks like, track it, and use the evidence to change what we teach.
* **Partner across customer teams.** Work with Transformation, Customer Success, Support Engineering and Product so enablement reflects real implementations, questions and product changes.

## What we're looking for

* 3–5 years in customer enablement, training, onboarding, customer education, implementation or a similar customer-facing role where teaching was central.
* You design learning, not just deliver it. You can turn a complex product into a curriculum with a clear sequence and outcomes.
* Confidence in front of a room, in person and on video, with senior lawyers as readily as with day-to-day users.
* Experience building self-paced content (courses, certifications, guides, video) and a view on what makes people finish it.
* A clear, warm communication style that makes unfamiliar ideas easy to grasp without oversimplifying them.
* Strong organisation: you can run several programmes, sessions and content deadlines at once without losing detail.
* Comfort with data. You can read product-usage information, spot where learning hasn't landed and act on it.
* Curiosity about AI and legal technology. You don't need a legal background, but you'll want to learn the product and our customers' work deeply.
* A strong learning mindset: you welcome feedback, apply coaching and want to grow quickly.

## How we work

We're an in-person team in Edinburgh, so expect to work from the office or visit customers by default. We set a high bar, move quickly and give people real ownership. There won't always be a playbook, so you'll bring curiosity, structure and persistence.

You'll work closely with the VP of Transformation and with Customer Success, Account Management and Product. Each customer team has a clear remit:

* **Transformation** leads implementation
* **Support Engineering** resolves technical issues
* **Account Management** owns renewals and commercial growth
* **Customer Success** owns adoption, customer health and value realisation
* **Enablement** owns onboarding, training and customer capability

## Why join Wordsmith

Wordsmith is growing quickly, winning new customers and expanding inside larger organisations. Because Legal AI is new to almost everyone who buys it, teaching it well is one of the highest-leverage things we can do.

You'll join early enough to define what customer enablement at Wordsmith is: the curriculum, the certifications, and the standard for what a confident user looks like. You'll work directly with ambitious legal teams, learn the product deeply and develop fast in a high-performing team.

Yahoo serves as a trusted guide for hundreds of millions of people globally, helping them achieve their goals online through our portfolio of iconic products. For advertisers, Yahoo Advertising offers omnichannel solutions and powerful data to engage with our brands and deliver results.

**A Little About Us**

  

When you impact millions of people every day, you become a large target for adversaries of all types within all layers of the stack. Our job is to keep our users safe and make Yahoo one of the safest places on the Internet. We are the information security team at Yahoo; known as "The Paranoids".

  

Within the Paranoids, Corporate Product Assurance is the review function for everything employees use to get their work done. Every new third-party product, SaaS integration, vendor connection, AI/LLM tool, and agentic connection entering the corporate environment comes through us before it touches Yahoo data, and we own the baseline configuration reviews and the annual check-in program for the products already in place. Intake and architecture review, MCP and agentic connection review, identity and access review - this is where a business owner who needs a tool today meets a corporate attack surface that has to stay governed.

**A Lot About You**

  

As a Paranoids Corporate Product Assurance Engineer, you own a review queue end to end - you take an intake request, understand the system and its trust boundaries, decide what the security requirements are, and close the review to a documented disposition inside an SLA. You will spend as much effort making reviews faster as you spend performing them, because rubrics, precedent, risk tiering, and agentic triage are how this function scales.

  

**Responsibilities**

  

* Own Paranoid Security Reviews for corporate systems end to end - new third-party SaaS, vendor integrations, employee-facing tools, cloud migrations, and AI/LLM products - from intake through documented disposition, holding review SLAs rather than accumulating an open queue.
* Review MCP and agentic connections as an extension of each connected data source's security perimeter: authentication and authorization, scope and consent, token issuance and rotation, audit coverage, and what an agent may act on without human authorization.
* Assess AI and LLM integrations for prompt injection, insecure output handling, sensitive data exposure through model inputs and outputs, and data retention and residency in vendor-hosted inference.
* Run baseline configuration reviews and the annual corporate-product check-in program, surfacing products that have aged past the review cycle threshold and reconciling the SaaS inventory against actual review history.
* Evidence data-classification, encryption, logging, and access-control (MFA/Okta) gates on completed reviews against Paranoids standards and industry frameworks (NIST, OWASP, CIS).
* Write dispositions a stakeholder can act on - what was observed, what it means, whether it blocks, who owns it, and what closes it.
* Build and tune the triage and first-pass review layer: risk tiering, precedent lookup against review history, enrichment, and the guardrails that decide what an agent may close and what escalates to a person.
* Verify AI-assisted and agent-drafted review output before it becomes a disposition, so every approval is explainable and nothing closes on an unverified model claim.
* Partner across queue boundaries with Third-Party Risk, Privacy, Legal, Enterprise Identity, Cloud Security, Network Security, and the MCP Gateway team so cross-domain reviews are not silently skipped in handoff.
* Drive down per-review effort through rubrics, templates, reusable control sets, and automation, so throughput improves without proportional headcount.
* Cross-train peers so every review type has at least two capable reviewers and the function carries no single-person dependency.

  

**Basic Qualifications**

  

* 6+ years of experience in product, application, or corporate/enterprise security, including 2+ years owning security reviews or an assurance function end to end.
* Demonstrated ownership of a review queue at volume - triage, prioritization, and closing reviews to a documented disposition under a service level, not only producing findings for someone else to resolve.
* Strong grasp of third-party and SaaS security assessment: tenant configuration, SSO and provisioning integration (SAML, OAuth 2.0, OIDC, SCIM), data flows across trust boundaries, subprocessors, and vendor data-handling commitments.
* Working knowledge of AI/LLM application security - prompt injection, insecure output handling, sensitive data exposure through model inputs and outputs, and the OWASP Top 10 for LLM Applications.
* Practical experience reviewing agentic and tool-use architectures (e.g., Model Context Protocol), including scope and consent, credential and token lifecycle, audit logging, and blast radius when an agent is compromised or misbehaves.
* Hands-on identity and access review experience with Okta or a comparable IdP: MFA enforcement, provisioning and deprovisioning, service accounts and non-human identity, and least-privilege grant review.
* Understanding of enterprise and collaboration infrastructure at scale - productivity suites, source control, ticketing, HR and finance platforms - and the data exposure patterns specific to each.
* Familiarity with industry security frameworks (NIST CSF, NIST AI RMF, OWASP, CIS Benchmarks) and the ability to apply them as a control-based critique rather than a checklist.
* Proven ability to turn a technical description into a control-based risk decision, and to write it so a non-security stakeholder can act on it.
* Comfort scripting and automating review workflow (e.g., Python) and working against the APIs of the systems under review.
* Strong stakeholder skills - able to hold a requirement under delivery pressure, and to say plainly what would change the answer.
* Bachelors Degree in a relevant field or equivalent work experience

**Preferred Qualifications**

  

* Experience standing up or materially improving a security review intake - routing, risk tiering, triage - and measuring the result.
* Hands-on experience with AI-assisted review tooling (LLM-powered triage, review agents, agent-drafted first-pass review) and an understanding of their limitations and failure modes.
* Experience defining guardrail policy for automated or agentic decisions: what may close without human touch, what must escalate, and how the decision is made explainable.
* Familiarity with SaaS Security Posture Management (SSPM) tooling, SaaS inventory reconciliation, and tenant configuration drift.
* Cloud-native security depth (AWS/GCP) for corporate workloads and vendor-hosted environments.
* Exposure to open-weight model hosting and agent harness controls - restricting what a model can act on without authorization.
* Experience with vendor security questionnaires and third-party risk cycles aligned to procurement renewal.
* Familiarity with model supply chain security - model and dataset provenance, weight integrity, and risks of third-party models and embeddings.
* Awareness of emerging AI security frameworks such as MITRE ATLAS and ISO/IEC 42001.
* Certifications such as CISSP, CCSP, CCSK, GWAPT, or CSSLP a plus, but not required.

# Strategic Operations

We are looking for someone entrepreneurial, technically minded and excited by the challenge of making a small deep-tech company operate with far more leverage than its size would suggest.

Zero Point Motion is building semiconductor sensors for physical AI, with a bigger ambition around owning more of the data and intelligence layer over time. That means we need a non-traditional operations role sitting somewhere between technology, company building and execution.

Make the company operate better and move faster. The first priority is using AI, automation and better systems to create leverage across a small team. The second is people, performance and quality, helping us maintain a very high bar as the team grows.

The third is working closely with the founder as a strategic operator across the parts of the company that do not sit neatly inside one function.

##### AI, automation and operational leverage

This is the biggest priority. We want Zero Point Motion to operate as an AI-native company beyond just for technical work. You will look across the business for repetitive work, poor information flow, unnecessary manual effort and processes that have not kept pace with the company, then work out how to improve them.

That could mean:

* building agents, automations and lightweight internal tools
* connecting systems so information does not have to be repeatedly copied or chased
* automating parts of recruitment, reporting, research, relationship management and company administration
* rapidly testing new AI tools and deciding which genuinely improve how we operate

You should be experienced in using AI, APIs, low-code tools and lightweight coding confidently enough to build and test things yourself. We want someone who already keeps up with AI and emerging technology because they are genuinely interested in it.

##### People, performance and quality

We have a very high bar for our technology. We want the same standard reflected in how the company operates. You will lead our Talent & Workplace Coordinator and Office Manager, helping turn this into a strong operational layer around the wider team.

You will:

* maintain a high bar for recruitment and continually improve how we find, assess and close exceptional people
* help us get more from a small team before assuming the answer is simply more headcount
* make ownership and expectations clearer to strengthen accountability
* build sensible gates so mistakes are caught before they create work elsewhere
* improve how meetings, handovers and internal communication work
* follow problems through to resolution rather than stopping at analysis or recommendations

We care a lot about people and want them to succeed, but we are also building a high-performance company. A major part of this role is helping translate the founder's quality threshold throughout the organisation.

##### Strategic operator to the founder

You will work closely with the founder and gain unusually broad exposure to how the company is being built. Some problems will arrive clearly defined but many will not. You might need to investigate why an important project keeps stalling, turn a loosely defined founder priority into clear actions and owners, prepare options around a strategic decision, or take something that currently falls between functions and drive it through to completion.

The work will change as the company changes. Examples might include:

* helping prepare for an investor, customer or Board discussion
* researching a strategic partner or market before an important decision
* making sure external relationships and follow-ups do not disappear between conversations
* helping communicate why our technology matters when there is a clear strategic reason to do so
* identifying a useful grant or non-dilutive funding opportunity and helping coordinate a strong response
* looking ahead at what the company is likely to need next and starting to build it before it becomes urgent

You do not need to arrive as an expert in investors, customers, grants or communications. What matters is that you are commercially aware, learn quickly and are comfortable getting deep enough into an unfamiliar area to make yourself useful.

Over time, you should understand the technology, people and business well enough to anticipate what the company needs next rather than simply responding to what has already happened.

##### Who we are looking for

There is no single conventional background for this role. What matters much more is evidence of how you think and what you have actually done.

**Required Background:**

* At least 2 years of experience in a high-ownership environment
* previous startup experience or experience working closely with startups.
* at minimum a bachelor's degree in a STEM subject, or equivalent technical experience.
* A genuine interest in technology with the ability and drive to implement technology in company operations

**You may have:**

* founded or helped build an early-stage company
* worked in consultancy or investment and decided you want to get much closer to actually building

**You are likely to:**

* think entrepreneurially
* move easily between strategic thinking and practical execution
* be extremely organised and close loops naturally
* have the judgement to challenge founders and colleagues constructively and naturally ask what could be faster, clearer or better
* care about high standards and team performance
* be willing to do unglamorous work when that is what is required to get something over the line

Titles matter much less to us.

##### What success looks like

Within 6–12 months, we should be able to point to visible changes in how the company operates because you joined.

**AI and operational leverage**

* At least three AI helpers, agents or automated workflows are live and being used, not sitting as prototypes.
* Those systems are materially reducing manual work, helping people find information faster, keeping information better organised, or carrying out useful spot-checks when processes or data start to drift.

**People, recruitment and company quality**

* Our Talent & Workplace Coordinator and Office Manager are operating as a stronger, more accountable and more effective team
* The quality of candidates entering later interview stages is improving, contributing to successful A-team hires as we grow.
* Efficiency gains create more capacity for the parts of company building that are easy to lose when everyone is busy, including team bonding, development and creating a great environment to work in.
* The founder's quality threshold is increasingly visible in how the wider company operates.

**Strategic execution**

* You have independently taken several ambiguous problems from identification through to solution.
* You have owned at least one or two substantial company-building projects, such as redesigning how we operate internally, evolving the company brand, taking ownership of a major customer opportunity, or leading a strategically important grant or funded programme from application through to delivery.
* You increasingly become someone the founder can bring into important decisions early, giving you direct exposure to fundraising, major commercial opportunities, strategic partnerships and the choices involved in scaling a deep-tech company.

##### Why this role is unusual

You will work directly with the founder at a stage where the company is still small enough for one exceptional person to change how it operates very quickly. There are very few layers between seeing something that could be better and actually changing it. If you build a better system, it can be in used that week. If you spot something slowing the company down, you can fix it. If you have a good idea, you will be surrounded by people with the intensity and technical ability to help make it real. That is a big part of what makes the role satisfying. You should be able to look back after six months and point to things that work differently because you joined.
